modules.module_objective: Establish the foundation, importance, legal weight, and PSC consequences of medical emergencies at sea.

scene_setup.location: Bridge of MV ATLAS PIONEER, North Atlantic, 14:20 UTC
scene_setup.weather: Wind SW 18 kts, Visibility 8 NM, Sea state moderate
scene_setup.context: Captain Ahmed addresses his deck officers in a pre-departure safety briefing. The course opens with a quick reality check: a real MEDEVAC starts before the injury happens — at the level of preparation.

dialogue.speaker: Master (Capt. Ahmed)
dialogue.english: Officers, every medical emergency at sea is a test of our preparation. Today's training will turn confusion into procedure.
dialogue.arabic: أيها الضباط، كل طارئ طبي في البحر هو اختبار لاستعدادنا. تدريب اليوم سيحول الارتباك إلى إجراء منظم.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A — Briefing not radio.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (Khaled)
dialogue.english: Master, the crew often hesitates between Pan-Pan and Medical Advice. We need clarity.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الطاقم غالباً يتردد بين Pan-Pan وطلب الاستشارة الطبية. نحتاج وضوح.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="92%">Officers, <break time="450ms"/> every medical emergency at sea <break time="300ms"/> is a test of our preparation. <break time="500ms"/> Today's training <break time="300ms"/> will turn confusion <break time="250ms"/> into procedure.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: What is the PRIMARY purpose of this MEDEVAC course?
interaction.question_ar: ما الهدف الأساسي من هذا الكورس؟

options.text: Memorize medical terminology
Convert hesitation into structured procedure under pressure
Replace the role of a doctor on board
Avoid all communication with shore

correct.text: Correct. The course objective is operational confidence — turning a panic moment into a sequence of clear, defendable actions.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الهدف هو الثقة العملية — تحويل لحظة الذعر إلى تسلسل واضح من الإجراءات القابلة للدفاع عنها.

incorrect.text: Incorrect. This is not a medical school. It is an officer's decision-making and communication course.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح. هذا ليس كلية طب، بل كورس اتخاذ قرار وتواصل للضابط.

real_consequence.description: Officers untrained in MEDEVAC procedure typically lose 15-25 minutes in the first call alone — a delay that has cost lives in real cases (MAIB Report 2017, fishing vessel cardiac arrest case).
real_consequence.psc_link: PSC may issue an ISM-related deficiency under Code 15150 if onboard drills don't reflect medical emergency preparedness.

lessons.lesson_title: Importance of Medical Emergencies at Sea

scene_setup.context: 3rd Officer Omar reviews a real-case briefing card. The discussion focuses on why medical emergencies at sea are categorically different from emergencies on land.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer (Omar)
dialogue.english: On land, an ambulance arrives in 8 minutes. At sea, MEDEVAC may take 4 to 12 hours. That changes everything.
dialogue.arabic: في البر، الإسعاف يصل في 8 دقائق. في البحر، الإخلاء الطبي قد يستغرق من 4 إلى 12 ساعة. هذا يغير كل شيء.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Correct. The first hour at sea is the officer's hour — not the doctor's.
dialogue.arabic: صحيح. الساعة الأولى في البحر هي ساعة الضابط — وليس الطبيب.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="92%">On land, <break time="300ms"/> an ambulance arrives in eight minutes. <break time="500ms"/> At sea, <break time="300ms"/> MEDEVAC may take <break time="200ms"/> four to twelve hours. <break time="500ms"/> That changes <break time="250ms"/> everything.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: A crew member reports chest pain at 02:00 UTC, mid-ocean, 600 NM from shore. What is the FIRST officer responsibility?
interaction.question_ar: فرد طاقم يبلغ عن ألم في الصدر الساعة 02:00، وسط المحيط، على بعد 600 ميل من الساحل. ما المسؤولية الأولى للضابط؟

options.text: Wait until morning to disturb the Master
Call Master immediately and prepare baseline patient assessment
Give patient aspirin and continue watch
Alter course toward nearest port without authorization

correct.text: Correct. Master must be called immediately for any suspected cardiac event. STCW and ISM both require this escalation. Time is myocardium.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. يجب استدعاء الكابتن فوراً لأي حدث قلبي مشتبه به. STCW و ISM يفرضان هذا التصعيد. الوقت = عضلة القلب.

incorrect.text: Incorrect — and in option A, this is a CRITICAL mistake. Delay in cardiac cases kills. Master must be informed immediately, day or night.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح — وفي الخيار A هذا خطأ كارثي. التأخير في حالات القلب يقتل. الكابتن يُبلغ فوراً، ليلاً أو نهاراً.

real_consequence.description: MAIB and USCG records show that delays of >30 minutes in cardiac MEDEVAC reporting reduce survival probability by approximately 50%.
real_consequence.psc_link: Failure to call Master is a direct breach of Master's standing orders → ISM non-conformity (Code 15150).

scene_setup.context: Master reviews a printed flag-state circular about an officer who was prosecuted after a delayed medical response. The lesson focuses on personal legal exposure.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Khaled, this 3rd Officer lost his license for 18 months. Reason — delayed reporting of a head injury.
dialogue.arabic: خالد، هذا الضابط الثالث فقد رخصته لمدة 18 شهراً. السبب — تأخير في الإبلاغ عن إصابة في الرأس.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Master, was it documented in the deck logbook?
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، هل تم توثيقه في دفتر العنبر؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Negative. No log entry, no written report. That is what destroyed his defense.
dialogue.arabic: لا. لا يوجد قيد في السجل، ولا تقرير مكتوب. هذا ما دمر دفاعه.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Khaled, <break time="400ms"/> this third officer <break time="300ms"/> lost his license <break time="300ms"/> for eighteen months. <break time="600ms"/> Reason <break time="300ms"/> — delayed reporting <break time="250ms"/> of a head injury.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which document is the OFFICER's strongest legal protection in a medical emergency?
interaction.question_ar: أي وثيقة هي الحماية القانونية الأقوى للضابط في حالة طارئ طبي؟

options.text: Verbal report to Master only
Time-stamped, signed deck logbook entry with patient observations and actions taken
WhatsApp message to the company DPA
Personal diary kept in cabin

correct.text: Correct. The deck logbook is a legal document. Time-stamped entries with vital signs, decisions, and actions are admissible in court and in flag-state inquiries.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. دفتر العنبر وثيقة قانونية. القيود الموقتة بالساعة مع العلامات الحيوية والقرارات والإجراءات مقبولة في المحاكم وتحقيقات دولة العلم.

incorrect.text: Incorrect. Only the official deck logbook (and where applicable, the medical log) carries full legal weight. Informal channels do not protect the officer.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح. فقط دفتر العنبر الرسمي (والسجل الطبي عند الإمكان) يحمل وزناً قانونياً كاملاً. القنوات غير الرسمية لا تحمي الضابط.

real_consequence.description: Per ILO MLC 2006 and STCW 2010, officers may face license suspension, criminal charges (negligent homicide in fatal cases), and civil liability if medical response is undocumented or delayed.
real_consequence.psc_link: Missing logbook entries → PSC deficiency under ISM Code Element 11 (Documentation), possible detention indicator.

lessons.lesson_title_ar: الارتباط مع مفتشية الميناء ومخاطر الاحتجاز

scene_setup.location: Bridge, 11:45 UTC, vessel approaching Rotterdam — Paris MoU port
scene_setup.context: PSCO boarding is expected within 2 hours. Master reviews the recent medical incident file with the Chief Officer to ensure no PSC trigger is missed.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Khaled, PSC will check the medical log first. Do we have all entries — incident, actions, MRCC contact, and shore advice?
dialogue.arabic: خالد، الـ PSC سيراجع السجل الطبي أولاً. هل لدينا كل القيود — الحادث، الإجراءات، التواصل مع MRCC، والاستشارة من البر؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Master, all logged. But the medical chest inventory was not updated after we used the morphine ampoule.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، كل شيء مسجل. لكن قائمة جرد الصيدلية لم تُحدث بعد استخدام أمبولة المورفين.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Update it now. Witnessed signature, time, quantity. That is a Paris MoU detention trigger if missing.
dialogue.arabic: حدثها الآن. توقيع شاهد، وقت، كمية. غيابها يستدعي احتجاز Paris MoU.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="92%">Update it now. <break time="500ms"/> Witnessed signature, <break time="300ms"/> time, <break time="300ms"/> quantity. <break time="500ms"/> That is a Paris MoU <break time="300ms"/> detention trigger <break time="300ms"/> if missing.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which of the following is the MOST LIKELY PSC detention finding after a recent medical incident?
interaction.question_ar: أي مما يلي هو السبب الأكثر احتمالاً لاحتجاز PSC بعد حادث طبي؟

options.text: Missing or unsigned medicine cabinet (controlled drugs) record
Crew uniforms not ironed
Coffee machine in mess broken
Missing Christmas decorations

correct.text: Correct. Controlled drug records (especially morphine and pethidine) are inspected on every Paris MoU and Tokyo MoU expanded inspection. Unsigned or missing entries are direct detention triggers under ILO MLC 2006 + Ship Captain's Medical Guide requirements.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. سجلات الأدوية المراقبة (خاصة المورفين والبيثيدين) تُفتش في كل تفتيش موسع لـ Paris MoU و Tokyo MoU. القيود غير الموقعة أو المفقودة تستدعي احتجازاً مباشراً تحت ILO MLC 2006 ودليل الكابتن الطبي.

incorrect.text: Incorrect. Cosmetic items are not detention triggers. Controlled drugs and medical logs are.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح. الأمور الشكلية لا تستدعي احتجاز. الأدوية المراقبة والسجلات الطبية هي ما يستدعي.

real_consequence.description: Paris MoU statistics 2022-2023 show that 'Medicine / Medical Equipment' deficiencies (Code 11101-11104) are among the top 25 detention causes for bulk carriers. Average detention: 36-72 hours, costing USD 25,000-60,000 in delays.
real_consequence.psc_link: Code 11101 (Medical Equipment), 11102 (Medical Reports), 11103 (Medical Care), 11104 (Medicine Chest).

modules.module_objective: Place the officer inside a real evolving incident from the moment of accident through initial assessment and the first decision.

scene_setup.location: Forward mooring station, MV ATLAS PIONEER, 06:42 UTC, departing port
scene_setup.weather: Wind variable 10 kts, dry, deck wet from morning dew
scene_setup.operation: Casting off — heaving in head line, 32mm polypropylene, under high tension toward shore bollard.
scene_setup.context: AB Mohammed Ali is operating the mooring winch. Bosun is supervising. Suddenly the mooring line parts under tension and the snap-back zone activates. Mohammed is struck on the right thigh and flank by the recoiling line. He falls, conscious but in severe pain.

dialogue.speaker: Bosun (handheld VHF)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Bosun forward. Line parted, snap-back, AB injured. Conscious, severe pain right leg. Need stretcher and Chief Officer NOW.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، البوصن من الأمام. الحبل قطع، snap-back، AB مصاب. واعي، ألم شديد في الرجل اليمنى. نحتاج نقالة والـ C/O الآن.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — BOSUN. LINE PARTED. AB INJURED. CONSCIOUS. NEED STRETCHER. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer (Bridge)
dialogue.english: Bosun, Bridge. Roger. Stretcher and C/O dispatched. Master informed. Stand by.
dialogue.arabic: بوصن، البرج. مفهوم. النقالة و الـ C/O في الطريق. الكابتن أُبلغ. ابق على استعداد.
dialogue.radio_short: ROGER. STRETCHER DISPATCHED. MASTER INFORMED. STAND BY. OVER.

voice_script.background_fx: VHF static, wind, distant winch hydraulic
voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="95%" pitch="+1st">Bridge, <break time="250ms"/> Bosun forward. <break time="400ms"/> Line parted, <break time="300ms"/> snap-back, <break time="300ms"/> AB injured. <break time="400ms"/> Conscious, <break time="300ms"/> severe pain right leg. <break time="400ms"/> Need stretcher <break time="250ms"/> and Chief Officer <break time="300ms"/> NOW.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: You are the 3rd Officer on bridge watch. You just received the Bosun's call. Mooring stations are still active. What do you do FIRST?
interaction.question_ar: أنت الضابط الثالث في وردية البرج. استلمت توا نداء البوصن. مناورة الشد ما زالت نشطة. ما أول إجراء؟

options.text: Sound General Alarm immediately
Acknowledge call, inform Master, dispatch C/O + stretcher, log time, hold mooring operation
Continue mooring operation to finish quickly, then attend casualty
Call MRCC directly without informing Master

correct.text: Correct. Acknowledge — Inform Master — Dispatch responders — Log time — HOLD the operation. Continuing mooring with an injured man on deck and parted lines is a second-accident generator.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تأكيد الاستلام — إبلاغ الكابتن — إرسال الفريق — تسجيل الوقت — إيقاف المناورة. الاستمرار في الشد مع مصاب على السطح وحبل مقطوع = توليد حادث ثانٍ.

incorrect.text: Option C is a CRITICAL mistake. Continuing operations with active hazards causes secondary casualties. General Alarm (option A) is for fire/abandon ship, not single casualty — it adds confusion. MRCC without Master (D) bypasses chain of command.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار C خطأ كارثي. الاستمرار مع وجود أخطار يولّد ضحايا إضافيين. جرس الإنذار العام (A) للحريق/التخلي، ليس لمصاب واحد — يخلق فوضى. الاتصال بـ MRCC بدون الكابتن (D) يتجاوز التسلسل القيادي.

real_consequence.description: MAIB report 2018 — bulk carrier in Tilbury: continuing mooring after first injury caused a second snap-back, killing the responding AB. Master and C/O faced manslaughter charges.
real_consequence.psc_link: ISM Code Element 7 (Shipboard Operations) — failure to stop unsafe operation = major non-conformity.

scene_setup.location: Forecastle deck, 06:44 UTC (T+2 minutes from incident)
scene_setup.context: Chief Officer Khaled arrives with stretcher team. AB Mohammed is on his back on the wet deck. Right thigh shows obvious deformity, blood seeping through trouser. He is pale, sweating, conscious but disoriented.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Mohammed, can you hear me? What is your name?
dialogue.arabic: محمد، تسمعني؟ ما اسمك؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A — direct casualty contact

dialogue.speaker: Patient (Mohammed)
dialogue.english: Yes... Chief... my leg... I cannot move it...
dialogue.arabic: نعم... شيف... رجلي... ما أقدر أحركها...
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (to handheld)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief. Patient conscious, oriented to name, severe right thigh injury, suspected fracture, active bleeding. DO NOT MOVE yet. Bring spinal board and first-aid kit.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، الـ Chief. المريض واعٍ، يعرف اسمه، إصابة شديدة في الفخذ الأيمن، اشتباه كسر، نزيف نشط. لا تحركوه. أرسلوا اللوح الفقري والإسعافات.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF. PATIENT CONSCIOUS. SUSPECT FRACTURE RIGHT THIGH. BLEEDING. SEND SPINAL BOARD. OVER.

voice_script.background_fx: Wind, distant ship hum, occasional gull
voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Bridge, <break time="300ms"/> Chief. <break time="400ms"/> Patient conscious, <break time="300ms"/> oriented to name, <break time="300ms"/> severe right thigh injury, <break time="300ms"/> suspected fracture, <break time="300ms"/> active bleeding. <break time="500ms"/> Do not move yet. <break time="500ms"/> Bring spinal board <break time="250ms"/> and first-aid kit.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Build the correct INITIAL discovery report from C/O to Bridge. Drag the elements in correct order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ تقرير الاكتشاف الصحيح من الـ C/O إلى البرج. رتّب العناصر.
elements_pool: Severe right thigh injury, suspected fracture, active bleeding.
Do not move yet. Bring spinal board and first-aid kit.
I think we need a helicopter.
correct_sequence: Severe right thigh injury, suspected fracture, active bleeding.
Do not move yet. Bring spinal board and first-aid kit.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Helicopter, family, and MRCC are NOT decisions for the C/O at this stage. They belong to the Master after assessment.

correct.text: Correct. Initial deck-to-bridge report = Identify yourself + Patient state + Injury + Immediate need + Out. Decisions about MEDEVAC, MRCC, and family come later.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تقرير السطح-للبرج = تعريف بالنفس + حالة المريض + الإصابة + الاحتياج الفوري + Out. قرارات الـ MEDEVAC و MRCC والأسرة تأتي لاحقاً.

incorrect.text: Incorrect. You included items outside your authority or skipped a critical element. The C/O reports facts and immediate needs — the Master decides escalation.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح. أدخلت بنوداً خارج صلاحيتك أو تجاوزت عنصراً حرجاً. الـ C/O يبلغ الحقائق والاحتياج الفوري — الكابتن يقرر التصعيد.

real_consequence.description: Confused initial reports lead to wrong equipment dispatched. In a real 2019 case (Tokyo MoU bulker), Master ordered Mayday based on C/O's panic call — actual injury was minor. Result: false Mayday, MRCC complaint, ISM audit finding.
real_consequence.psc_link: False distress alerts → ITU Radio Regulations breach → flag-state warning, possible PSC follow-up.

scene_setup.context: C/O performs primary survey while waiting for Master. He uses the AVPU + ABCDE approach taught in STCW Medical First Aid (A-VI/4-1).

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Mohammed, squeeze my hand. Both hands. Good. Do you feel your right foot?
dialogue.arabic: محمد، اضغط على يدي. الاثنين. ممتاز. تحس برجلك اليمنى؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes Chief... but pain very bad...
dialogue.arabic: نعم شيف... لكن الألم شديد جداً...
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (to 3/O on radio)
dialogue.english: Bridge — primary assessment. AVPU: Alert. Airway clear. Breathing 22 per minute, shallow. Pulse 110 regular. Bleeding right thigh, controlled with direct pressure. Pain 8 of 10. Suspect closed femur fracture. No neurological deficit. Ready Master decision.
dialogue.arabic: البرج — تقييم أولي. AVPU: واعي. مجرى الهواء سليم. التنفس 22 ضحل. النبض 110 منتظم. نزيف الفخذ مسيطر عليه بضغط مباشر. الألم 8 من 10. اشتباه كسر مغلق في الفخذ. لا عجز عصبي. جاهز لقرار الكابتن.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — PRIMARY DONE. ALERT. RR 22. PULSE 110. BLEED CONTROLLED. SUSPECT CLOSED FEMUR. READY FOR MASTER. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Bridge <break time="250ms"/> — primary assessment. <break time="500ms"/> AVPU: Alert. <break time="400ms"/> Airway clear. <break time="400ms"/> Breathing twenty-two per minute, <break time="250ms"/> shallow. <break time="400ms"/> Pulse one-ten, <break time="250ms"/> regular. <break time="400ms"/> Bleeding right thigh, <break time="250ms"/> controlled with direct pressure. <break time="400ms"/> Pain eight of ten. <break time="400ms"/> Suspect closed femur fracture. <break time="400ms"/> No neurological deficit. <break time="500ms"/> Ready Master decision.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: In the AVPU + ABCDE primary survey, what does the 'V' in AVPU stand for, and when do you record it?
interaction.question_ar: في التقييم الأولي AVPU، ماذا يعني الحرف V ومتى يُسجل؟

options.text: Vital — record blood pressure first
Voice — patient responds only to verbal stimulus, not spontaneously alert
Vomit — sign of head injury
Visual — patient can see

correct.text: Correct. AVPU = Alert / Voice-responsive / Pain-responsive / Unresponsive. It is a fast neurological scale used before GCS in maritime first aid (STCW A-VI/4-1).
correct.text_ar: صحيح. AVPU = واعٍ / يستجيب للصوت / يستجيب للألم / لا يستجيب. مقياس عصبي سريع يُستخدم قبل GCS في الإسعاف البحري (STCW A-VI/4-1).

incorrect.text: Incorrect. AVPU is a neurological assessment scale, not a vital-signs check. Master and shore doctor depend on it to assess consciousness level.
incorrect.text_ar: غير صحيح. AVPU مقياس عصبي وليس فحص علامات حيوية. الكابتن والطبيب على البر يعتمدون عليه لتقييم مستوى الوعي.

real_consequence.description: Wrong consciousness reporting leads to wrong MEDEVAC priority. CIRM (Italian telemedical service) reports that 30% of unnecessary helicopter calls stem from poor AVPU/GCS reporting.
real_consequence.psc_link: STCW VI/4 competence gap — possible deficiency under crew certification audit.

scene_setup.context: Master arrives on bridge. He has the C/O's primary survey, vessel position 80 NM offshore, ETA next port 14 hours. He must make THE first decision: contact shore for medical advice now, or continue assessment?

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Omar, position?
dialogue.arabic: عمر، الموقع؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: Master, position 51° 24' North 002° 18' East, 80 nautical miles from nearest port, course 095, speed 12 knots.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الموقع 51 درجة 24 شمال 002 درجة 18 شرق، 80 ميل من أقرب ميناء، الاتجاه 095، السرعة 12 عقدة.
dialogue.radio_short: POS 51-24N 002-18E. 80 NM TO PORT. CSE 095. SPD 12.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Suspected closed femur fracture, controlled bleeding, conscious. This is NOT Mayday. NOT Pan-Pan yet. We initiate REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE to MRCC. Omar, draft DSC alert — Medical Priority. Khaled, stabilize patient, do not move to hospital ward yet.
dialogue.arabic: اشتباه كسر مغلق فخذ، نزيف مسيطر عليه، واعٍ. هذه ليست Mayday. وليست Pan-Pan بعد. نبدأ Request Medical Advice إلى MRCC. عمر، حضّر تنبيه DSC — أولوية طبية. خالد، ثبّت المريض، لا تنقله إلى المشفى بعد.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A — internal command

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Suspected closed femur fracture, <break time="300ms"/> controlled bleeding, <break time="300ms"/> conscious. <break time="500ms"/> This is NOT Mayday. <break time="400ms"/> NOT Pan-Pan yet. <break time="500ms"/> We initiate <break time="300ms"/> Request Medical Advice <break time="300ms"/> to MRCC.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Master has decided. As 3rd Officer, you must select the CORRECT call type for this case.
interaction.question_ar: الكابتن قرر. كضابط ثالث، اختر النوع الصحيح للنداء.

options.text: MAYDAY — vessel in grave and imminent danger
PAN-PAN MEDICO — urgency for medical assistance
REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE — patient stable, controlled bleeding, need shore doctor input
Routine call — no urgency

correct.text: Correct. Master applied the IMO escalation ladder: Routine → Request Medical Advice → Pan-Pan Medico (urgent transport needed) → Mayday (life threatening / cannot be saved on board). At this stage, patient is stable. Wrong escalation = wasted MRCC resources, possible flag-state warning.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الكابتن طبق سلم التصعيد من IMO: Routine → Request Medical Advice → Pan-Pan Medico (نقل عاجل مطلوب) → Mayday (تهديد حياة لا يمكن إنقاذه على السفينة). الآن المريض مستقر. التصعيد الخاطئ = هدر موارد MRCC وإنذار من دولة العلم.

incorrect.text: Option A (MAYDAY) is a CRITICAL mistake — false distress alert is a serious offense under ITU Radio Regulations, can lead to fines and license action. Pan-Pan is too soon when patient is stable. Routine misses urgency.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار A (MAYDAY) خطأ كارثي — إشارة استغاثة كاذبة جريمة بموجب لوائح الراديو الدولية، قد تؤدي لغرامات وعقوبات على الرخصة. Pan-Pan سابق لأوانه. Routine يفقد العجالة.

real_consequence.description: Real case: Tokyo MoU bulker 2020 declared Mayday for a fractured wrist. Result: USCG aircraft launched, USD 380,000 recovery cost, charges against the Master. Lesson — match the call to the medical reality.
real_consequence.psc_link: False distress = ITU violation + possible flag-state suspension. PSC will note GMDSS log entries on next inspection.

modules.module_objective: Master the IMO call-type ladder, ship identification, declaration of medical emergency, and full initial call construction.

lessons.lesson_title: Types of Calls — Mayday / Pan-Pan / Medical Advice
lessons.lesson_title_ar: أنواع النداءات — Mayday / Pan-Pan / استشارة طبية

scene_setup.context: 3rd Officer prepares the call. He must select the correct procedural word — wrong choice = wrong international response.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Omar, three call levels. Distinguish them — out loud.
dialogue.arabic: عمر، ثلاثة مستويات للنداء. ميزها — بصوت عالٍ.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: MAYDAY — grave and imminent danger to life or vessel — distress, top priority. PAN-PAN — urgency, no immediate threat to life of all on board. PAN-PAN MEDICO — urgent medical assistance/MEDEVAC needed. REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE — non-urgent doctor consultation, patient stable.
dialogue.arabic: MAYDAY — خطر داهم وجسيم على الحياة أو السفينة — استغاثة، أعلى أولوية. PAN-PAN — استعجال، بدون تهديد فوري على الحياة للجميع. PAN-PAN MEDICO — حاجة عاجلة لمساعدة طبية / إخلاء. REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE — استشارة طبيب غير عاجلة، المريض مستقر.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">MAYDAY <break time="500ms"/> — grave and imminent danger to life or vessel <break time="400ms"/> — distress, <break time="300ms"/> top priority. <break time="700ms"/> PAN-PAN <break time="400ms"/> — urgency, <break time="300ms"/> no immediate threat to life of all on board. <break time="700ms"/> PAN-PAN MEDICO <break time="400ms"/> — urgent medical assistance <break time="250ms"/> or MEDEVAC needed. <break time="700ms"/> REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE <break time="400ms"/> — non-urgent doctor consultation, <break time="300ms"/> patient stable.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: A crew member has a high fever (39.5°C), nausea, abdominal pain, but is conscious, vital signs stable, vessel 200 NM from port. CORRECT call type?
interaction.question_ar: فرد طاقم لديه حمى مرتفعة (39.5°)، غثيان، ألم بطن، واعٍ، علامات حيوية مستقرة، السفينة على بعد 200 ميل من الميناء. النداء الصحيح؟

options.text: MAYDAY
PAN-PAN MEDICO
REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE
No call needed, treat with paracetamol

correct.text: Correct. Patient stable but symptoms unclear (could be appendicitis, gastroenteritis, etc.). Shore doctor consultation via Request Medical Advice is the right level. If condition worsens → escalate to Pan-Pan Medico.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. المريض مستقر لكن الأعراض غير واضحة (قد يكون التهاب زائدة، أو معدة...). الاستشارة الطبية من البر هي المستوى الصحيح. إن ساءت الحالة → نصعّد إلى Pan-Pan Medico.

incorrect.text: Mayday is for grave imminent danger only. 'No call' is critical negligence — undiagnosed abdominal pain at sea can be fatal (e.g., appendicitis rupture). Pan-Pan Medico is for urgent transport, not initial advice.
incorrect.text_ar: Mayday للخطر الداهم فقط. 'بدون نداء' إهمال كارثي — ألم البطن غير المشخص في البحر قد يكون مميتاً (مثل انفجار الزائدة). Pan-Pan Medico للنقل العاجل، ليس للاستشارة الأولى.

real_consequence.description: CIRM Genoa data 2021: 60% of telemedical consultations are at the 'Request Medical Advice' level. Of these, only 12% later escalate to MEDEVAC. Correct first-level selection saves lives and resources.
real_consequence.psc_link: GMDSS log review during PSC inspection — wrong call types flagged under SOLAS Ch. IV.

lessons.lesson_title: When to Use REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE

scene_setup.context: Master defines the threshold. The call type is decided not by the injury alone but by stability + ability to manage on board + distance from definitive care.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Omar — three questions. One: is the patient stable? Two: can we manage on board for the next 6 to 12 hours? Three: do we need a doctor's expert input now? If yes, yes, yes — Request Medical Advice.
dialogue.arabic: عمر — ثلاثة أسئلة. واحد: المريض مستقر؟ اثنان: نقدر نتعامل على السفينة خلال 6 إلى 12 ساعة القادمة؟ ثلاثة: نحتاج رأي طبيب الآن؟ إذا نعم، نعم، نعم — Request Medical Advice.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Three questions. <break time="500ms"/> One: <break time="300ms"/> is the patient stable? <break time="500ms"/> Two: <break time="300ms"/> can we manage on board <break time="250ms"/> for the next six to twelve hours? <break time="500ms"/> Three: <break time="300ms"/> do we need a doctor's expert input <break time="250ms"/> now? <break time="700ms"/> If yes, yes, yes <break time="400ms"/> — Request Medical Advice.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which scenario is the BEST FIT for Request Medical Advice (not Pan-Pan, not Mayday)?
interaction.question_ar: أي سيناريو يناسب Request Medical Advice (وليس Pan-Pan ولا Mayday)؟

options.text: Crew with chest pain, sweating, vomiting — clinically suspect AMI
Cook with stable laceration on hand, requires suturing decision and antibiotic guidance
AB lost consciousness, irregular breathing
Engine cadet with crushed hand, severe arterial bleeding

correct.text: Correct. The cook is stable; the question is procedural — suture or not, antibiotic choice, infection risk. Perfect fit for Request Medical Advice. Cases A, C, D are Pan-Pan Medico or Mayday level.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الطباخ مستقر؛ السؤال إجرائي — خياطة أم لا، اختيار مضاد حيوي، خطر العدوى. مناسب تماماً لـ Request Medical Advice. الحالات A و C و D من مستوى Pan-Pan Medico أو Mayday.

incorrect.text: Cases of suspected heart attack, unconsciousness, or arterial bleeding are URGENCY/DISTRESS — not advice level. Underestimating them costs lives.
incorrect.text_ar: حالات الاشتباه بنوبة قلبية، أو فقدان الوعي، أو نزيف شرياني هي استعجال / استغاثة — وليست مستوى استشارة. التقليل من شأنها يكلف حياة.

real_consequence.description: CIRM 2020 case: Master used 'Request Medical Advice' for crew with chest pain. Doctor immediately upgraded to Pan-Pan Medico. Lesson — when in doubt, escalate; do not hold back.
real_consequence.psc_link: Wrong assessment may show in ISM internal audit — competence gap (Element 6).

scene_setup.context: Before any call, the officer must have ALL identification details ready. Wasted seconds = wasted opportunity.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer (rehearsing)
dialogue.english: This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER. Callsign Three Foxtrot Alpha Papa Seven. MMSI three-five-two-one-two-three-four-five-six. Position five-one degrees two-four minutes North, zero-zero-two degrees one-eight minutes East. Course zero-nine-five, speed one-two knots.

interaction.question: Build the correct ship identification block in IMO SMCP order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ بلوك تعريف السفينة بالترتيب الصحيح وفق IMO SMCP.
elements_pool: This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER.
correct_sequence: This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Personal info and company contact go later. SMCP requires: Vessel name (×3) → Callsign → MMSI → Position → Course/Speed → Over.

correct.text: Correct. SMCP standard ship-identification block — name (×3) for clarity over noisy channels, then unique IDs, then position/movement, then OVER for response.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. بلوك التعريف القياسي — الاسم (×3) للوضوح عبر القنوات المزعجة، ثم المعرفات الفريدة، ثم الموقع/الحركة، ثم OVER لطلب الرد.

incorrect.text: You missed elements or added irrelevant ones. SMCP requires precision and minimum noise. Personal/company info comes only after MRCC requests follow-up.
incorrect.text_ar: تجاوزت عناصر أو أضفت غير ذات صلة. SMCP يتطلب دقة وحد أدنى من الضوضاء. المعلومات الشخصية/الشركة تأتي فقط بعد طلب MRCC.

real_consequence.description: MRCC operators report that incomplete ship ID adds 3-7 minutes per call — in mass-casualty events this matters. Vessels with confused IDs are deprioritized in queue.
real_consequence.psc_link: GMDSS log incomplete entries → SOLAS Ch. IV Reg. 17 deficiency.

scene_setup.context: After ship identification, the procedural word for medical emergency must be declared with precision.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer (on Inmarsat-C / VHF Ch.16)
dialogue.english: MRCC, MRCC, MRCC, this is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER. REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE. We have one injured crew member. Over.
dialogue.arabic: MRCC، MRCC، MRCC، هذه ناقلة الحبوب ATLAS PIONEER. أطلب استشارة طبية. لدينا فرد طاقم مصاب. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MRCC x3 — ATLAS PIONEER — REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE — ONE INJURED — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: MRCC Operator
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, MRCC. Read you loud and clear. Stand by for medical officer. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، MRCC. أسمعك واضحاً. ابق على استعداد للطبيب. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER, MRCC. LOUD AND CLEAR. STAND BY FOR DOCTOR. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">MRCC, <break time="250ms"/> MRCC, <break time="250ms"/> MRCC, <break time="500ms"/> this is bulk carrier <break time="300ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER. <break time="600ms"/> REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE. <break time="500ms"/> We have one injured crew member. <break time="400ms"/> Over.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which procedural element MUST come immediately after the addressee (MRCC ×3) and ship identification, when declaring a medical emergency?
interaction.question_ar: أي عنصر إجرائي يجب أن يأتي فور بعد المرسل إليه (MRCC ×3) وتعريف السفينة عند إعلان حالة طبية؟

options.text: Patient's full medical history
Procedural phrase: REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE / PAN-PAN MEDICO / MAYDAY
Weather report
Vessel cargo manifest

correct.text: Correct. The procedural phrase tells the receiver IMMEDIATELY what response is required. Without it, the call is just a conversation, not an emergency declaration.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. العبارة الإجرائية تخبر المستقبل فوراً ما هو الرد المطلوب. بدونها، المكالمة مجرد حديث، وليست إعلان طارئ.

incorrect.text: Medical history, weather, and cargo come AFTER the procedural phrase. The phrase activates the correct response chain at MRCC.
incorrect.text_ar: التاريخ الطبي والطقس والبضاعة يأتون بعد العبارة الإجرائية. هذه العبارة تفعّل سلسلة الاستجابة الصحيحة في MRCC.

real_consequence.description: MRCC training data: calls without clear procedural word are classified as 'unclear traffic' and may be delayed up to 10 minutes for clarification.
real_consequence.psc_link: Communication failure → SOLAS Ch. IV / IMO SMCP non-compliance.

scene_setup.context: 3rd Officer assembles the COMPLETE first call. This is the model call to be used in real life and assessed.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer (full transmission)
dialogue.english: MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth — this is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER. Callsign 3FAP7. MMSI 352123456. Position 51 degrees 24 minutes North, 002 degrees 18 minutes East. Course 095, speed 12 knots. REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE. We have one injured crew member, mooring accident, suspected closed femur fracture, conscious, stable. Standing by Channel 16 and Channel 70 DSC. Over.
dialogue.arabic: MRCC Falmouth (×3) — هذه ناقلة الحبوب ATLAS PIONEER (×3). علامة النداء 3FAP7. MMSI 352123456. الموقع 51-24 شمال، 002-18 شرق. الاتجاه 095، السرعة 12 عقدة. أطلب استشارة طبية. لدينا فرد طاقم مصاب، حادث ربط، اشتباه كسر مغلق فخذ، واعٍ، مستقر. أنا على القناة 16 والقناة 70 DSC. تحويل.

interaction.question: Build the FULL initial Request Medical Advice call to MRCC. Drag-and-drop in correct order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ نداء Request Medical Advice الكامل إلى MRCC. اسحب وأفلت بالترتيب الصحيح.
elements_pool: MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth.
This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER.
One injured crew member, mooring accident, suspected closed femur fracture, conscious, stable.
Standing by Channel 16 and Channel 70 DSC.
correct_sequence: MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth, MRCC Falmouth.
This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER, ATLAS PIONEER.
One injured crew member, mooring accident, suspected closed femur fracture, conscious, stable.
Standing by Channel 16 and Channel 70 DSC.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Order = Addressee → Identification → Position/Movement → Procedural phrase → Brief medical summary → Listening watch → Over. Coffee break is irrelevant noise.

correct.text: Excellent. This is the model SMCP-compliant medical-advice call. Time to build = under 60 seconds with practice. Save this as your reference template.
correct.text_ar: ممتاز. هذا النداء النموذجي المتوافق مع SMCP. زمن البناء = أقل من 60 ثانية مع التدريب. احفظه كقالب مرجعي.

incorrect.text: Order or completeness wrong. Missing any element forces MRCC to ask back, wasting golden minutes.
incorrect.text_ar: الترتيب أو الاكتمال غير صحيح. غياب أي عنصر يجبر MRCC على إعادة السؤال، مهدراً دقائق ذهبية.

real_consequence.description: Well-constructed first call reduces total MEDEVAC coordination time by an average of 22% (UK MCA study, 2019). That can be the margin between life and death in cardiac/trauma cases.
real_consequence.psc_link: PSC may review last 6 months of GMDSS logs — well-formed calls = professional crew.

modules.module_objective: Report patient condition with medical precision: consciousness, breathing, bleeding, critical conditions, deterioration, and full structured report.

scene_setup.context: Shore doctor (via MRCC) asks for consciousness level. Officer must report using AVPU and GCS approximation.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor (via MRCC)
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, doctor on the line. Report patient consciousness level — AVPU please. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، الطبيب معك. أبلغني بمستوى الوعي — AVPU من فضلك. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — DOCTOR — AVPU PLEASE — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Doctor, patient is ALERT on AVPU. Oriented to person, place, and time. Glasgow estimated 15. Pain 8 of 10. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، المريض ALERT على AVPU. يعرف نفسه والمكان والوقت. غلاسكو تقريبي 15. ألم 8 من 10. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — PT ALERT — ORIENTED x3 — GCS 15 — PAIN 8/10 — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Doctor, <break time="400ms"/> patient is ALERT on AVPU. <break time="500ms"/> Oriented to person, <break time="250ms"/> place, <break time="250ms"/> and time. <break time="500ms"/> Glasgow estimated fifteen. <break time="500ms"/> Pain eight of ten. <break time="400ms"/> Over.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Patient opens eyes when you call his name, talks confused words, withdraws from pain. What is the AVPU level?
interaction.question_ar: المريض يفتح عينيه عندما تنادي باسمه، يتكلم كلاماً مشوشاً، يسحب من الألم. ما مستوى AVPU؟

options.text: A — Alert
V — Voice-responsive
P — Pain-responsive only
U — Unresponsive

correct.text: Correct. Eyes open to voice = V. Confused speech ≠ Alert (which requires full orientation). Important: V on AVPU corresponds to GCS 12-13 approximately — already a serious sign.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. فتح العينين على الصوت = V. الكلام المشوش ≠ Alert (Alert يتطلب توجهاً كاملاً). مهم: V على AVPU يقابل تقريباً GCS 12-13 — وهي علامة خطيرة بالفعل.

incorrect.text: Alert means spontaneously oriented, not responsive to voice. Patient who needs to be called is V. Misclassification leads to wrong MEDEVAC priority.
incorrect.text_ar: Alert تعني واعٍ تلقائياً ومتوجهاً، وليس مستجيباً للصوت. المريض الذي يحتاج لمن يناديه هو V. التصنيف الخاطئ = أولوية إخلاء خاطئة.

real_consequence.description: Wrong AVPU report causes shore doctor to under-prioritize. Documented case (CIRM 2020): head injury reported as 'Alert' actually was V; MEDEVAC delayed 4 hours, patient developed brain herniation.
real_consequence.psc_link: Wrong vital reporting → STCW VI/4 competence issue → potential PSC interview finding.

scene_setup.context: C/O reports respiratory parameters. Shore doctor relies on rate, effort, and oxygen saturation if available.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (to bridge)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief. Respiratory rate 26 per minute, shallow, no cyanosis, no accessory muscle use. SpO2 not measured — no pulse oximeter on deck.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، الـ Chief. معدل التنفس 26 في الدقيقة، ضحل، لا يوجد ازرقاق، لا استخدام لعضلات إضافية. SpO2 غير مقاس — لا يوجد جهاز قياس على السطح.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF — RR 26 SHALLOW. NO CYANOSIS. NO SPO2 ON DECK. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Chief, take patient to ship's hospital — controlled, on stretcher. Use the pulse oximeter from medical chest. Report SpO2 on arrival.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، انقل المريض إلى مشفى السفينة — بطريقة منضبطة، على النقالة. استخدم جهاز قياس الأكسجين من الصيدلية. أبلغني SpO2 عند الوصول.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — TRANSFER TO HOSPITAL — STRETCHER — REPORT SPO2 — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Bridge, <break time="300ms"/> Chief. <break time="500ms"/> Respiratory rate <break time="250ms"/> twenty-six per minute, <break time="300ms"/> shallow, <break time="300ms"/> no cyanosis, <break time="300ms"/> no accessory muscle use. <break time="500ms"/> SpO2 not measured <break time="300ms"/> — no pulse oximeter on deck.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which respiratory parameter is the EARLIEST and MOST SENSITIVE indicator of patient deterioration that an officer can measure?
interaction.question_ar: أي معيار تنفسي هو الأول والأكثر حساسية لتدهور المريض ويستطيع الضابط قياسه؟

options.text: Skin color only
Respiratory rate (breaths per minute) trend over time
Patient's appetite
Body temperature

correct.text: Correct. Respiratory rate is the EARLIEST vital to change in shock, head injury, sepsis, and pulmonary problems. Normal adult: 12-20/min. >24 or <10 = red flag. Trend matters more than single value.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. معدل التنفس أول علامة حيوية تتغير في الصدمة، إصابات الرأس، تعفن الدم، ومشاكل الرئة. الطبيعي للبالغ: 12-20/د. >24 أو <10 = إنذار. الاتجاه أهم من قيمة واحدة.

incorrect.text: Skin color is late. Appetite irrelevant in acute. Temperature is for infection, not acute trauma. Respiratory rate is your earliest warning.
incorrect.text_ar: لون الجلد متأخر. الشهية غير مهمة في الحاد. الحرارة للعدوى وليس الإصابة الحادة. معدل التنفس هو الإنذار المبكر.

real_consequence.description: MERSAR/IAMSAR Vol III emphasizes respiratory rate trending. UK studies: 70% of deteriorating patients show rising RR 4-8 hours BEFORE collapse — but only if officers measure it serially.
real_consequence.psc_link: Lack of pulse oximeter or BP cuff on board may trigger PSC deficiency under medical equipment requirements (Code 11101).

scene_setup.context: Patient transferred to hospital. Wound re-exposed. Bleeding pattern must be classified for shore doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief in hospital. Wound right thigh, lacerated, approximately 8 by 3 centimeters. Bleeding venous — slow steady ooze, dark red. Direct pressure applied with sterile gauze plus pressure bandage. Bleeding controlled. Estimated blood loss 400 milliliters.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، الـ Chief في المستشفى. جرح فخذ يمين، تمزق، تقريباً 8×3 سم. النزيف وريدي — تسرّب بطيء ومتصل، أحمر داكن. ضغط مباشر بشاش معقم + ضمادة ضغط. النزيف مسيطر عليه. الفقد المقدر 400 مل.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF — WOUND R THIGH 8x3CM — VENOUS BLEED — CONTROLLED. EBL 400ML. OVER.

interaction.question: Bright red blood SPURTING in pulses from a wound — what type, and what is the FIRST action?
interaction.question_ar: دم أحمر فاتح يندفع بنبضات من جرح — ما نوعه وما الإجراء الأول؟

options.text: Venous — apply ice
Arterial — apply firm direct pressure immediately, elevate if possible, prepare tourniquet if pressure fails
Capillary — light bandage
Internal — give patient water

correct.text: Correct. Spurting bright red = arterial. Pressure FIRST. If pressure fails → tourniquet (limb only) per latest TCCC guidelines now adopted by IAMSAR. Note: tourniquet is no longer 'last resort' — it is acceptable early in arterial limb bleeding.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الاندفاع الأحمر الفاتح = شرياني. الضغط أولاً. إن فشل → عاصبة (للأطراف فقط) وفق إرشادات TCCC المعتمدة في IAMSAR. ملاحظة: العاصبة لم تعد 'الخيار الأخير' — بل مقبولة مبكراً في النزيف الشرياني للأطراف.

incorrect.text: Giving water to a bleeding/shock patient (D) is a CRITICAL mistake — risk of aspiration and worsens shock physiology. Ice does not stop bleeding. Light bandage will not control arterial flow.
incorrect.text_ar: إعطاء ماء لمريض نزيف/صدمة (D) خطأ كارثي — خطر استنشاق وتفاقم الصدمة. الثلج لا يوقف النزيف. الضمادة الخفيفة لا توقف الجريان الشرياني.

real_consequence.description: Adult femoral artery bleed can cause death in 3-5 minutes. Recent maritime trauma data (UK MCA 2022) credits onboard tourniquets with at least 4 documented life saves in the past 5 years.
real_consequence.psc_link: Missing or expired tourniquets in medical chest = PSC deficiency Code 11104.

scene_setup.context: Time pressure: although our main scenario patient is stable, the doctor cross-trains the team on a parallel critical case — chest pain crew member elsewhere on the vessel could happen anytime. Officer must know red flags.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Master, I want to test your team. If a 50-year-old crew comes with crushing chest pain radiating to left arm, sweating, nausea, what call type, what immediate actions?
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، أريد اختبار فريقك. لو فرد طاقم عمره 50 جاء بألم سحقي في الصدر يمتد للذراع اليسرى، تعرق، غثيان — ما نوع النداء، وما الإجراءات الفورية؟
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — TEST — 50YO CRUSHING CHEST PAIN, LEFT ARM, SWEAT — CALL TYPE? ACTIONS? OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: PAN-PAN MEDICO immediately. Patient sit upright, oxygen if available, aspirin 300 milligrams chewed if no allergy, GTN if prescribed, monitor pulse and breathing, prepare AED, log every 5 minutes. Plan MEDEVAC.
dialogue.arabic: PAN-PAN MEDICO فوراً. المريض جالساً، أكسجين إذا متوفر، أسبرين 300 ملغ مضغ إن لم يكن لديه حساسية، GTN إن موصوف، مراقبة النبض والتنفس، تجهيز AED، توثيق كل 5 دقائق. التخطيط للإخلاء.
dialogue.radio_short: PAN-PAN MEDICO. UPRIGHT. O2. ASA 300MG CHEWED. AED READY. LOG Q5MIN. PLAN MEDEVAC. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">PAN-PAN MEDICO immediately. <break time="500ms"/> Patient sit upright, <break time="300ms"/> oxygen if available, <break time="300ms"/> aspirin three hundred milligrams chewed <break time="250ms"/> if no allergy, <break time="400ms"/> GTN if prescribed, <break time="400ms"/> monitor pulse and breathing, <break time="300ms"/> prepare AED, <break time="300ms"/> log every five minutes. <break time="500ms"/> Plan MEDEVAC.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which combination is a RED FLAG indicating possible Acute Myocardial Infarction (heart attack) at sea?
interaction.question_ar: أي تركيبة هي علامة حمراء لاحتمال احتشاء عضلة قلبية حاد في البحر؟

options.text: Mild chest soreness after lifting boxes, relieved by rest within 1 minute
Crushing chest pain >15 min, radiating to left arm/jaw, sweating, nausea, anxiety
Sharp chest pain when pressing on chest wall
Chest tightness only when laughing

correct.text: Correct. Classic AMI red-flag cluster: prolonged crushing pain + radiation + autonomic symptoms (sweat, nausea) + anxiety. Time = myocardium. Aspirin chewed is the single most life-saving onboard action while waiting for MEDEVAC.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تجمع علامات AMI الكلاسيكي: ألم سحقي مطول + امتداد + أعراض ذاتية (تعرق، غثيان) + قلق. الوقت = عضلة القلب. الأسبرين الممضوغ هو أكثر إجراء واحد منقذ للحياة على السفينة بانتظار الإخلاء.

incorrect.text: Mild reproducible chest pain with movement is musculoskeletal. The classic AMI cluster is what kills if missed.
incorrect.text_ar: الألم البسيط المعتمد على الحركة عضلي هيكلي. التجمع الكلاسيكي لـ AMI هو القاتل إن غاب.

real_consequence.description: Heart attack survival at sea drops 7-10% per hour of delay (American Heart Association data extrapolated to maritime). Missed AMI = high probability of fatal arrhythmia in transit.
real_consequence.psc_link: Missing AED on bulk carriers >500 GT = ILO MLC 2006 deficiency, possible detention.

scene_setup.context: Mohammed (our patient) shows changing vitals: pulse rising (110→128), BP dropping (120/80→100/65), pale, restless. C/O recognizes early shock and must escalate.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (urgent, to bridge)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief. Patient deteriorating. Pulse climbed from 110 to 128. BP dropped from 120 over 80 to 100 over 65. Pale, restless, anxious. Suspect early hypovolemic shock — possible internal bleed or thigh hematoma expansion. Recommend ESCALATE to Pan-Pan Medico and request MEDEVAC.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، الـ Chief. المريض يتدهور. النبض ارتفع من 110 إلى 128. الضغط نزل من 120/80 إلى 100/65. شاحب، قلق، متهيج. اشتباه صدمة نقص حجم مبكرة — احتمال نزيف داخلي أو توسع الورم الدموي في الفخذ. أوصي بالتصعيد إلى Pan-Pan Medico وطلب MEDEVAC.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF — PT DETERIORATING. PULSE 110→128. BP 120/80→100/65. PALE/RESTLESS. SUSPECT EARLY SHOCK. RECOMMEND PAN-PAN MEDICO + MEDEVAC. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Roger Chief. Escalating now. Omar — call MRCC, upgrade to Pan-Pan Medico, request MEDEVAC, advise position, weather, helideck readiness.
dialogue.arabic: مفهوم Chief. أصعّد الآن. عمر — اتصل بـ MRCC، صعّد إلى Pan-Pan Medico، اطلب MEDEVAC، أبلغ بالموقع والطقس وجاهزية موقع الهبوط.
dialogue.radio_short: ROGER. ESCALATE NOW. OMAR — MRCC PAN-PAN MEDICO + MEDEVAC + POS/WX/HELI INFO.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="92%" pitch="+1st">Bridge, <break time="250ms"/> Chief. <break time="400ms"/> Patient deteriorating. <break time="500ms"/> Pulse climbed from one-ten <break time="250ms"/> to one-twenty-eight. <break time="400ms"/> BP dropped from one-twenty over eighty <break time="250ms"/> to one-hundred over sixty-five. <break time="500ms"/> Pale, <break time="250ms"/> restless, <break time="250ms"/> anxious. <break time="500ms"/> Suspect early hypovolemic shock <break time="400ms"/> — possible internal bleed <break time="300ms"/> or thigh hematoma expansion. <break time="500ms"/> Recommend ESCALATE <break time="300ms"/> to Pan-Pan Medico <break time="300ms"/> and request MEDEVAC.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: You are the Master. C/O reports the deterioration above. What is your DECISION sequence within the next 60 seconds?
interaction.question_ar: أنت الكابتن. الـ C/O يبلغك بالتدهور أعلاه. ما تسلسل قرارك في 60 ثانية؟

options.text: Wait 30 min and re-check vitals before deciding
Escalate to Pan-Pan Medico, request MEDEVAC, prepare helideck, alter course toward MEDEVAC area, log every 5 min
Continue Request Medical Advice — same call
Declare Mayday immediately

correct.text: Correct. Deterioration = upgrade. The escalation is: Request Medical Advice → Pan-Pan Medico → (only if life-threatening with no shore option) Mayday. The Master's role is to anticipate, not react late.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. التدهور = ترقية. التصعيد: Request Medical Advice → Pan-Pan Medico → (فقط إذا تهديد الحياة بدون خيار من البر) Mayday. دور الكابتن أن يتوقع، وليس أن يتأخر.

incorrect.text: Waiting 30 min on a deteriorating shock patient is CRITICAL — patient may arrest. Mayday is premature when shore can still respond. Continuing same level ignores the change. The art is timely escalation.
incorrect.text_ar: الانتظار 30 دقيقة على مريض صدمة متدهور خطأ كارثي — قد يصاب بسكتة. Mayday سابق لأوانه. الاستمرار على نفس المستوى يتجاهل التغير. الفن هو التصعيد في وقته.

real_consequence.description: Hypovolemic shock fatality jumps significantly when systolic BP falls below 90 mmHg without intervention. Real case: Tokyo MoU 2018, fractured femur with delayed escalation → patient died in transit. Master prosecuted.
real_consequence.psc_link: ISM Code Element 8 (Emergency Preparedness) audit — failure to escalate in time = major non-conformity.

scene_setup.context: Master delivers a structured SBAR-format patient report to the shore doctor. SBAR (Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) is the maritime + medical gold standard.

dialogue.speaker: Master (full report)
dialogue.english: MRCC, ATLAS PIONEER, Master. SBAR report. SITUATION — 34-year-old male AB, conscious, deteriorating, suspected hypovolemic shock. BACKGROUND — mooring line snap-back at 06:42 UTC, suspected closed femur fracture, controlled external bleed approximately 400 milliliters. No prior medical history known. ASSESSMENT — pulse 128, BP 100 over 65, RR 26, SpO2 94 percent on air, GCS 14, pain 8 of 10, pale and restless. RECOMMENDATION — upgrade Pan-Pan Medico, request MEDEVAC by helicopter, ETA next port 14 hours which is too long. Standing by for orders. Over.
dialogue.arabic: MRCC، ATLAS PIONEER، الكابتن. تقرير SBAR. الوضع (S) — ذكر 34 سنة AB، واعٍ، يتدهور، اشتباه صدمة نقص حجم. الخلفية (B) — ارتداد حبل ربط الساعة 06:42 UTC، اشتباه كسر مغلق فخذ، نزيف خارجي مسيطر عليه تقريباً 400 مل. لا تاريخ مرضي معروف. التقييم (A) — النبض 128، الضغط 100/65، التنفس 26، الأكسجين 94٪ على الهواء، GCS 14، الألم 8/10، شاحب ومتهيج. التوصية (R) — الترقية إلى Pan-Pan Medico، طلب MEDEVAC بالهليكوبتر، وقت الوصول للميناء 14 ساعة طويل جداً. أنا بانتظار الأوامر. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MRCC — ATLAS PIONEER — SBAR. S: 34M AB DETERIORATING SHOCK. B: MOORING ACCIDENT 06:42, FEMUR FX, EBL 400ML. A: P128 BP100/65 RR26 SPO2 94% GCS14. R: UPGRADE PAN-PAN MEDICO + MEDEVAC. ETA PORT 14H TOO LONG. STAND BY. OVER.

interaction.question: Build the FULL SBAR patient report. Drag elements into S → B → A → R order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ تقرير المريض الكامل بنظام SBAR. رتّب العناصر S → B → A → R.
elements_pool: [S] 34yo male AB, conscious, deteriorating, suspected hypovolemic shock.
[B] Mooring line snap-back 06:42 UTC, suspected closed femur fracture, EBL 400 ml. No prior history.
[A] Pulse 128, BP 100/65, RR 26, SpO2 94%, GCS 14, pain 8/10, pale/restless.
[R] Upgrade Pan-Pan Medico, request MEDEVAC by helicopter, ETA port 14h too long. Stand by.
Crew member's birthday is next week.
We bought new ropes last month.
correct_sequence: [S] 34yo male AB, conscious, deteriorating, suspected hypovolemic shock.
[B] Mooring line snap-back 06:42 UTC, suspected closed femur fracture, EBL 400 ml. No prior history.
[A] Pulse 128, BP 100/65, RR 26, SpO2 94%, GCS 14, pain 8/10, pale/restless.
[R] Upgrade Pan-Pan Medico, request MEDEVAC by helicopter, ETA port 14h too long. Stand by.
interaction.distractor_explanation: SBAR is fixed in clinical communication: Situation → Background → Assessment → Recommendation. Irrelevant info (birthday, rope purchase) is filtered out.

correct.text: Excellent. SBAR is the international clinical communication standard now adopted in maritime medicine (CIRM, MRCC, USCG). It saves cognitive load for the receiving doctor and reduces errors.
correct.text_ar: ممتاز. SBAR هو المعيار العالمي للتواصل الطبي، معتمد في الطب البحري (CIRM، MRCC، USCG). يقلل العبء الذهني على الطبيب المتلقي ويقلل الأخطاء.

incorrect.text: Order broken or extras included. Receiving doctor needs the FOUR sections in SBAR order — anything else is noise.
incorrect.text_ar: الترتيب مكسور أو مع إضافات. الطبيب المتلقي يحتاج الأقسام الأربعة بترتيب SBAR — أي شيء آخر ضوضاء.

real_consequence.description: CIRM Genoa adopted SBAR in 2018; their data shows 35% reduction in clarification call-backs and 18% faster MEDEVAC decision time. Direct patient-life impact.
real_consequence.psc_link: PSC may review medical log entries — properly structured (SBAR-style) entries demonstrate ISM competence.

modules.module_objective: Document and communicate the incident itself with legal-grade precision: what happened, what type of injury, when (UTC), and how the mechanism links to the medical condition.

scene_setup.context: Shore doctor needs the MECHANISM of injury — not just the result. Mechanism dictates suspected hidden injuries (internal bleed, spinal, head). Master must describe the event factually, without speculation, without blame.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor (via MRCC)
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, Doctor. Describe the incident mechanism. I need facts only. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، الطبيب. صف لي آلية الحادث. أحتاج حقائق فقط. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — DOCTOR — DESCRIBE MECHANISM. FACTS ONLY. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Doctor, mechanism: cast-off mooring operation, head line 32 millimeter polypropylene under tension. Line parted at the bollard end approximately 06:42 UTC. Recoil struck patient on right thigh and right flank. Patient was inside the marked snap-back zone. Distance of strike approximately 4 meters. Impact force estimated high. Patient fell on deck, did NOT strike head, no loss of consciousness witnessed. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، الآلية: عملية فك أحبال، حبل أمامي 32 ملم بولي بروبلين تحت شد. الحبل قطع عند نهاية الميرفع تقريباً 06:42 UTC. الارتداد ضرب المريض في الفخذ الأيمن والخاصرة اليمنى. المريض كان داخل منطقة snap-back. مسافة الضربة تقريباً 4 متر. القوة المقدرة عالية. المريض سقط على السطح، لم يضرب رأسه، لم يفقد وعيه أمام شهود. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — MECHANISM: 32MM PP HEAD LINE PARTED 06:42 UTC. SNAP-BACK STRIKE R THIGH/FLANK ~4M. HIGH FORCE. NO HEAD STRIKE. NO LOC. OVER.

interaction.question: Which element is MOST IMPORTANT to include when describing an injury mechanism to the shore doctor?
interaction.question_ar: أي عنصر هو الأهم عند وصف آلية الإصابة للطبيب على البر؟

options.text: The crew member's nationality and religion
Type of force, point of impact, body region struck, presence/absence of head strike or LOC
Whether the bosun was wearing his hat
Speculation about who is at fault

correct.text: Correct. Mechanism = force type + impact point + body region + head/LOC status. From this, the doctor predicts hidden injuries (e.g., flank strike → suspect kidney/internal bleed; thigh strike → suspect femur fracture/femoral artery). Speculation about fault belongs in the investigation report — NOT the medical call.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الآلية = نوع القوة + نقطة الاصطدام + المنطقة المصابة + حالة الرأس/الوعي. من هذه يتنبأ الطبيب بالإصابات الخفية (ضربة على الخاصرة → اشتباه كلية/نزيف داخلي؛ على الفخذ → اشتباه كسر فخذ/شريان فخذي). التكهن بالمسؤولية يخص تقرير التحقيق — وليس النداء الطبي.

incorrect.text: Option D is a CRITICAL mistake. Stating 'fault' on a recorded GMDSS channel before investigation is legally toxic — used against the company in court. Stay factual.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار D خطأ كارثي. تحديد 'المسؤولية' على قناة GMDSS مسجلة قبل التحقيق سام قانونياً — يُستخدم ضد الشركة في المحاكم. ابقَ على الحقائق.

real_consequence.description: MAIB and BSU (Germany) reports repeatedly cite cases where Master's recorded VHF speculation about crew error became evidence in wrongful-death lawsuits. Stick to mechanism, not blame.
real_consequence.psc_link: Inadequate incident description in deck log → ISM Element 9 (Reports & Analysis of Non-Conformities) finding.

lessons.lesson_title: Type of Injury — Fall / Mooring / Equipment

scene_setup.context: C/O drafts the formal incident classification for the medical log. Each injury type has predictable hidden-injury patterns the doctor will check for.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Khaled, classify the injury. Three categories: fall, mooring/line, equipment crush. Be precise.
dialogue.arabic: خالد، صنّف الإصابة. ثلاث فئات: سقوط، ربط/حبل، سحق بمعدات. كن دقيقاً.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A — internal

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Master, primary mechanism: MOORING — line snap-back, blunt force trauma right lower limb and right flank. Secondary mechanism: FALL — patient fell from standing height to deck immediately after impact. No equipment crush component.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الآلية الأساسية: ربط — ارتداد حبل، رضّ بقوة على الطرف السفلي الأيمن والخاصرة. الآلية الثانوية: سقوط — المريض سقط من ارتفاع الوقوف على السطح بعد الضربة مباشرة. لا يوجد عنصر سحق بمعدات.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

interaction.question: Match the injury TYPE with its MOST LIKELY hidden injury risk:
interaction.question_ar: طابق نوع الإصابة مع الإصابة الخفية الأكثر احتمالاً:

options.text: Fall from height (>2m) → Spinal injury, internal abdominal bleed, head injury
Mooring snap-back to torso → Rib fractures, pneumothorax, internal organ injury
Equipment crush of hand → Bone fracture, neurovascular damage, compartment syndrome
Paper cut on finger → Massive blood loss and shock

interaction.interaction_note: Multi-correct: A, B, C all valid clinical patterns. D is incorrect.

correct.text: Correct. Each mechanism has predictable hidden risks. Fall = spine/head/abdomen. Snap-back to torso = ribs/lung/organ. Crush = neurovascular + compartment syndrome. The doctor uses these patterns to direct your secondary survey.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. كل آلية لها مخاطر خفية متوقعة. السقوط = عمود فقري/رأس/بطن. ارتداد على الجذع = ضلوع/رئة/أعضاء. سحق = أوعية وأعصاب + متلازمة الحجرة. الطبيب يستخدم هذه الأنماط لتوجيه فحصك الثانوي.

incorrect.text: Paper cut does not cause shock. The other three are real high-risk patterns documented in maritime trauma literature.
incorrect.text_ar: جرح ورق لا يسبب صدمة. الثلاثة الأخرى أنماط عالية الخطورة موثقة في الأدبيات البحرية.

real_consequence.description: Compartment syndrome from crush injury is missed in 25% of maritime cases — leading to limb amputation if MEDEVAC delayed >6 hours. Recognition of mechanism patterns saves limbs and lives.
real_consequence.psc_link: Untrained crew on mechanism-based assessment → STCW VI/4 competence finding.

interaction.question: Why is UTC mandatory for medical/emergency log entries?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا UTC إلزامي في القيود الطبية / الطارئة؟

options.text: It is shorter to write than local time
Universal reference — eliminates time-zone confusion across MRCC, doctor, helicopter, flag state, and court
It is required only on Sundays
Personal preference of the Master

correct.text: Correct. Patient may be on a Panama-flagged vessel, calling Falmouth MRCC, picked up by Dutch helicopter, treated in Belgian hospital, with crew agency in Manila. ONE common time = UTC. Local time creates fatal coordination errors.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. المريض قد يكون على سفينة بنمية، يتصل بـ MRCC Falmouth، تأتيه هليكوبتر هولندية، يُعالج في مستشفى بلجيكي، ووكالة الطاقم في مانيلا. وقت موحد = UTC. الوقت المحلي يولّد أخطاء تنسيق قاتلة.

incorrect.text: UTC is not aesthetic — it is operational and legal. Mixing local and UTC in one log is a recurring finding in casualty investigations.
incorrect.text_ar: UTC ليس شكلياً — بل تشغيلي وقانوني. خلط المحلي و UTC في نفس السجل ملاحظة متكررة في تحقيقات الحوادث.

real_consequence.description: MAIB Report 2019 (cargo vessel North Sea): conflicting time stamps in deck log vs medical log delayed insurance claim by 14 months and weakened defense in fatality inquiry.
real_consequence.psc_link: Inconsistent time entries → ISM Element 11 (Documentation) deficiency, possible Paris MoU detention indicator.

scene_setup.context: Shore doctor draws the chain: mechanism → injury → physiological response → current condition. This is the clinical narrative, not a list of facts.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Master, link it for me. From line parting to current shock — one clinical chain. Over.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، اربطها لي. من قطع الحبل إلى الصدمة الحالية — سلسلة سريرية واحدة. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — LINK MECHANISM TO CURRENT STATE — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Doctor, chain as follows. Snap-back at 06:42 UTC delivered high-energy blunt impact to right thigh. Closed femur fracture and significant deep-tissue hematoma developed. Internal blood loss into thigh compartment estimated 1 to 1.5 liters in addition to 400 milliliters external. Hypovolemia developed by 07:35 UTC, presenting as compensatory tachycardia 128 and falling blood pressure 100 over 65. Patient still compensating but deteriorating. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، السلسلة كالتالي. ارتداد الحبل 06:42 UTC نقل ضربة عالية الطاقة على الفخذ الأيمن. تطور كسر مغلق في الفخذ + ورم دموي عميق كبير. فقد الدم الداخلي في حجرة الفخذ مقدر 1 إلى 1.5 لتر بالإضافة إلى 400 مل خارجياً. ظهر نقص الحجم بحلول 07:35 UTC على شكل تسارع نبض تعويضي 128 وانخفاض ضغط 100/65. المريض لا يزال يعوّض لكنه يتدهور. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — SNAP-BACK 06:42 → CLOSED FEMUR FX + DEEP HEMATOMA → INTERNAL EBL 1-1.5L + 400ML EXT → HYPOVOLEMIA 07:35 → P128 BP100/65 COMPENSATING. OVER.

interaction.question: Build the CLINICAL CHAIN linking the mooring incident to current shock state. Drag in correct cause→effect order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ السلسلة السريرية من حادث الربط إلى حالة الصدمة الحالية. رتّب بترتيب السبب→النتيجة.
elements_pool: Snap-back impact 06:42 UTC delivered high-energy blunt force to right thigh.
Closed femur fracture + deep-tissue hematoma developed.
Internal blood loss ~1-1.5L into thigh compartment + 400ml external bleed.
Patient compensating but deteriorating — MEDEVAC required.
correct_sequence: Snap-back impact 06:42 UTC delivered high-energy blunt force to right thigh.
Closed femur fracture + deep-tissue hematoma developed.
Internal blood loss ~1-1.5L into thigh compartment + 400ml external bleed.
Patient compensating but deteriorating — MEDEVAC required.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Emotional details (scared, guilty) belong to crew welfare follow-up, not the clinical chain delivered to the doctor.

correct.text: Correct. The clinical chain = Mechanism → Anatomical injury → Pathophysiology → Vital signs change → Current state → Recommendation. This is what shore doctors call 'thinking like a clinician.'
correct.text_ar: صحيح. السلسلة السريرية = الآلية → الإصابة التشريحية → الفسيولوجيا المرضية → تغير العلامات الحيوية → الحالة الحالية → التوصية. هذا ما يسميه الأطباء 'التفكير سريرياً'.

incorrect.text: Order broken or non-clinical items added. Without the chain, the doctor cannot anticipate decline trajectory, cannot prioritize MEDEVAC.
incorrect.text_ar: الترتيب مكسور أو دخلت عناصر غير سريرية. بدون السلسلة، الطبيب لا يستطيع توقع منحنى التدهور، ولا ترتيب أولوية الإخلاء.

real_consequence.description: Clinical chain reasoning is the core of advanced first aid for masters (STCW A-VI/4-2). Cases where Master gave only fragmented facts (no chain) saw 40% longer MEDEVAC response time.
real_consequence.psc_link: STCW A-VI/4-2 certification mismatch in crew list → PSC certificate verification finding.

modules.module_objective: Apply correct first-aid procedures: control bleeding, immobilize, stretcher transport, monitor vital signs, document stability — every action defendable, every step logged.

scene_setup.context: C/O reviews actions already taken with the shore doctor. The list must be precise: what was done, by whom, at what time, with what result.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Doctor, actions taken so far. 06:46 UTC — primary survey, AVPU Alert. 06:50 UTC — direct pressure to right thigh wound, sterile gauze plus pressure bandage. 06:55 UTC — patient log roll, spinal precautions, transferred to stretcher. 07:05 UTC — moved to ship's hospital. 07:10 UTC — patient on examination bed, body warmed with blanket, head and torso slightly elevated, injured leg supported and immobilized straight. Pain medication NOT yet given pending your authorization. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، الإجراءات حتى الآن. 06:46 UTC — فحص أولي، AVPU واعٍ. 06:50 UTC — ضغط مباشر على جرح الفخذ الأيمن، شاش معقم + ضمادة ضغط. 06:55 UTC — قلب المريض جانبياً مع حماية العمود الفقري، ونقله إلى نقالة. 07:05 UTC — نُقل إلى مشفى السفينة. 07:10 UTC — على سرير الفحص، تدفئة ببطانية، رفع الرأس والجذع قليلاً، الساق المصابة مدعومة ومثبّتة مستقيمة. لم تُعطَ مسكنات بانتظار إذنك. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — ACTIONS: 06:46 PRIM SURVEY. 06:50 DIRECT PRESSURE + BANDAGE. 06:55 LOG ROLL/STRETCHER. 07:05 TO HOSPITAL. 07:10 WARMED, ELEVATED, LIMB IMMOBILIZED. NO ANALGESIA YET. OVER.
