interaction.question: Why did the Master/C/O delay giving pain medication despite patient pain 8/10?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا أخّر الكابتن / الـ C/O إعطاء المسكنات رغم ألم 8/10؟

options.text: To save morphine ampoules for later
Strong analgesia (especially opioids like morphine) requires shore doctor authorization, can mask deterioration, can suppress respiration in shock — must be doctor-directed
No reason — they forgot
To punish the patient

correct.text: Correct. Onboard opioid administration is a clinical decision that requires shore doctor approval, controlled-drug logging (witnessed signature), and respiratory monitoring. Giving morphine to a hypovolemic patient without doctor authority can drop BP and mask deterioration → fatal in transit. Ship Captain's Medical Guide is explicit on this.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. إعطاء المواد الأفيونية على السفينة قرار سريري يتطلب إذن الطبيب، وتوثيق الدواء المراقب (توقيع شاهد)، ومراقبة التنفس. إعطاء مورفين لمريض نقص حجم بدون إذن قد يُسقط الضغط ويخفي التدهور → مميت أثناء النقل. دليل الكابتن الطبي صريح في ذلك.

incorrect.text: There is a clinical and regulatory reason — not a personal one. Self-authorized opioid use on ship has caused fatalities and master prosecutions.
incorrect.text_ar: السبب سريري وتنظيمي — وليس شخصي. الاستخدام الذاتي للمواد الأفيونية على السفن سبّب وفيات ومحاكمات للكباتن.

real_consequence.description: Tokyo MoU 2021 case: Master gave 2 morphine ampoules without doctor authorization, no witnessed log entry. Patient died en route (combined hypovolemia + opioid respiratory depression). Master criminally charged.
real_consequence.psc_link: Controlled-drug log discrepancy → IMMEDIATE Paris MoU and Tokyo MoU detention trigger (Code 11104).

scene_setup.context: C/O re-checks the wound. Bandage soaked through but bleeding controlled. Doctor instructs the correct over-bandaging technique — never remove a soaked bandage, layer over it.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Chief, do NOT remove the soaked bandage. Apply a fresh sterile pad and pressure bandage OVER it. Removing disrupts the clot. Confirm bleeding still controlled. Over.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، لا تنزع الضمادة المشبعة. ضع شاش معقم جديد وضمادة ضغط فوقها. النزع يكسر الجلطة. أكد أن النزيف لا يزال مسيطراً عليه. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — DO NOT REMOVE SOAKED BANDAGE. ADD STERILE PAD + PRESSURE OVER. CONFIRM CONTROLLED. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Doctor, executed. New sterile pad over original, pressure bandage applied firm but not tourniquet. Distal pulse on right foot present. Toes warm, pink, sensation normal. Bleeding controlled. No further soak observed. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، نُفذ. شاش جديد فوق الأصلي، ضمادة ضغط مشدودة لكن ليست عاصبة. النبض البعيد على القدم اليمنى موجود. الأصابع دافئة، وردية، الإحساس طبيعي. النزيف مسيطر عليه. لا تشبع جديد. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — DONE. PAD OVER + PRESSURE. DISTAL PULSE PRESENT. TOES WARM/PINK/SENSATION OK. CONTROLLED. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Chief, <break time="400ms"/> do NOT remove <break time="300ms"/> the soaked bandage. <break time="500ms"/> Apply a fresh sterile pad <break time="300ms"/> and pressure bandage <break time="300ms"/> OVER it. <break time="500ms"/> Removing <break time="300ms"/> disrupts the clot. <break time="500ms"/> Confirm bleeding <break time="300ms"/> still controlled. <break time="400ms"/> Over.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: After applying a pressure bandage, which CHECK confirms it is firm enough to control bleeding but NOT tight enough to cause limb ischemia?
interaction.question_ar: بعد ضمادة الضغط، أي فحص يؤكد أنها مشدودة بما يكفي للسيطرة على النزيف لكن ليس لدرجة قطع الدوران؟

options.text: Patient stops complaining
Distal pulse present + warm pink toes/fingers + normal sensation distal to bandage
Bandage feels tight to the officer
Visible color of bandage fabric

correct.text: Correct. The 6 P's of limb ischemia: Pulse (absent), Pallor, Paresthesia, Paralysis, Pain (worsening), Poikilothermia (cold). After bandaging, the officer must check distal pulse, color, warmth, and sensation every 15 min and log them. Missing this = limb loss.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. علامات نقص التروية: غياب النبض، شحوب، تنميل، شلل، ألم متفاقم، برودة. بعد الضمادة، يفحص الضابط النبض البعيد واللون والدفء والإحساس كل 15 دقيقة ويوثقهم. تجاهل ذلك = فقد الطرف.

incorrect.text: Patient comfort, officer's feel, and bandage color are subjective. Only objective distal neurovascular checks confirm safety.
incorrect.text_ar: راحة المريض، إحساس الضابط، ولون الضمادة كلها ذاتية. فقط الفحص العصبي/الوعائي البعيد الموضوعي يؤكد السلامة.

real_consequence.description: Maritime trauma cases (UK MCA 2018-2022) document at least 3 amputations from over-tight pressure bandages where distal checks were skipped. Compartment syndrome appears within 4-6 hours.
real_consequence.psc_link: Crew not trained in distal neurovascular check → STCW VI/4 competence finding.

scene_setup.context: Suspected closed femur fracture must be immobilized BEFORE helicopter transport. Improper splinting in flight can convert closed fracture to open, sever the femoral artery.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Chief, immobilize the right femur. Use traction splint if available, or rigid splint with padding. Splint must extend from above hip to below ankle. Secure with broad straps, NOT directly over the suspected fracture site. Confirm distal pulse after splinting. Over.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، ثبّت الفخذ الأيمن. استخدم traction splint إن توفر، أو جبيرة صلبة مع توسيد. الجبيرة من فوق الحوض إلى تحت الكاحل. ثبّت بأشرطة عريضة، ليس فوق موقع الكسر مباشرة. أكد النبض البعيد بعد التثبيت. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — IMMOBILIZE R FEMUR. TRACTION OR RIGID SPLINT. HIP→ANKLE. STRAPS NOT OVER FX. RECHECK DISTAL PULSE. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Doctor, executed. Rigid splint applied — wood and padded gauze. Length from above right iliac crest to below right ankle. Three broad straps — thigh upper, knee proximal, ankle. Distal pulse re-checked, present and equal. Patient pain decreased to 6 of 10. Ready for transport. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، نُفذ. جبيرة صلبة — خشب وشاش موسد. الطول من فوق العرف الحرقفي الأيمن إلى تحت الكاحل الأيمن. ثلاثة أشرطة عريضة — أعلى الفخذ، فوق الركبة، الكاحل. النبض البعيد فُحص، موجود ومتساوٍ. الألم نزل إلى 6/10. جاهز للنقل. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — DONE. RIGID SPLINT, ILIAC→ANKLE. 3 STRAPS. PULSE EQUAL. PAIN 6/10. READY TRANSPORT. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Chief, <break time="400ms"/> immobilize the right femur. <break time="500ms"/> Use traction splint if available, <break time="300ms"/> or rigid splint with padding. <break time="500ms"/> Splint must extend <break time="300ms"/> from above hip <break time="250ms"/> to below ankle. <break time="500ms"/> Secure with broad straps, <break time="300ms"/> NOT directly over the suspected fracture site. <break time="500ms"/> Confirm distal pulse <break time="300ms"/> after splinting.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Splint for a suspected closed femur fracture must extend:
interaction.question_ar: الجبيرة لكسر فخذ مغلق مشتبه يجب أن تمتد:

options.text: From knee to ankle only
From above hip joint to below ankle joint — immobilizing the joint above and below the fracture
Only over the visible deformity
From shoulder to foot

correct.text: Correct. Universal splinting rule: immobilize the joint ABOVE and the joint BELOW the fracture. For femur, that means hip + knee. Ankle is included for stability. Knee-to-ankle splint leaves the femur free to move = useless.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. القاعدة العالمية: ثبّت المفصل الذي فوق الكسر والمفصل الذي تحته. للفخذ يعني الورك + الركبة. الكاحل يضاف للثبات. ركبة-كاحل فقط تترك الفخذ يتحرك = بدون فائدة.

incorrect.text: Knee-to-ankle leaves the fracture free to move during helicopter winching → catastrophic. Shoulder-to-foot is over-immobilization and impractical.
incorrect.text_ar: ركبة-كاحل تترك الكسر حراً أثناء الرفع بالهليكوبتر → كارثي. كتف-قدم تثبيت زائد وغير عملي.

real_consequence.description: USCG MEDEVAC reports document multiple cases where inadequate femur splinting during helicopter winch converted closed fractures to open with arterial damage. One fatality in 2017.
real_consequence.psc_link: Splinting equipment missing/expired in medical chest → Code 11101 deficiency.

scene_setup.location: Ship's hospital → corridor → helideck route, 08:30 UTC
scene_setup.context: C/O selects the correct stretcher type for helicopter MEDEVAC. Wrong stretcher = winching delay or fall.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Khaled, helicopter is en route, ETA 35 minutes. Stretcher choice?
dialogue.arabic: خالد، الهليكوبتر قادمة، الوصول 35 دقيقة. اختيار النقالة؟
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Master, helicopter winching requires either NESTED Neil Robertson stretcher or BASKET stretcher with vertical lift harness. Standard scoop stretcher is NOT certified for winching. Recommend Neil Robertson — full body wrap, secure for vertical and horizontal lift.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الرفع بالهليكوبتر يتطلب إما Neil Robertson stretcher أو Basket stretcher بحبال رفع عمودية. النقالة العادية scoop غير معتمدة للرفع. أوصي بـ Neil Robertson — لف كامل للجسم، آمنة للرفع العمودي والأفقي.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — NEIL ROBERTSON STRETCHER. SCOOP NOT CERTIFIED FOR WINCH. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Master, <break time="400ms"/> helicopter winching requires <break time="300ms"/> either NESTED Neil Robertson stretcher <break time="300ms"/> or BASKET stretcher <break time="300ms"/> with vertical lift harness. <break time="500ms"/> Standard scoop stretcher <break time="300ms"/> is NOT certified for winching. <break time="500ms"/> Recommend Neil Robertson <break time="300ms"/> — full body wrap, <break time="250ms"/> secure for vertical and horizontal lift.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which stretcher is the BEST primary choice for helicopter winching of a femur-fracture patient at sea?
interaction.question_ar: أي نقالة هي الخيار الأفضل لرفع مريض كسر فخذ بالهليكوبتر؟

options.text: Standard hospital wheeled trolley
Neil Robertson stretcher OR Basket stretcher with vertical lift harness
Scoop stretcher only
Improvised stretcher from blankets and broomsticks

correct.text: Correct. Neil Robertson (canvas + wood/aluminum slats with full-body wrap straps) and metal basket stretcher are the two SOLAS-recognized helicopter-compatible stretchers. The helicopter usually lowers its own stretcher, but the ship must have at least one onboard for transfer to helideck or use during winching delay.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. Neil Robertson (قماش + ألواح خشب/ألمنيوم مع أحزمة لف كامل) والـ Basket المعدنية هما النقالتان المعتمدتان لـ SOLAS للهليكوبتر. الهليكوبتر عادة تنزل نقالتها الخاصة، لكن السفينة يجب أن تحوي واحدة على الأقل للنقل إلى موقع الهبوط أو أثناء التأخير.

incorrect.text: Wheeled trolley cannot be winched. Scoop stretcher is for transfer only, not winching. Improvised stretcher (D) is a CRITICAL mistake — guaranteed to fail under helicopter rotor downwash.
incorrect.text_ar: الترولي لا يمكن رفعه. Scoop للنقل فقط. النقالة المرتجلة (D) خطأ كارثي — مضمونة الفشل تحت تيار الهواء من الهليكوبتر.

real_consequence.description: USCG and IAMSAR Vol III document accidents where improvised stretchers failed during winching, dropping patients. Neil Robertson is the ship's standard worldwide.
real_consequence.psc_link: Missing approved stretcher = SOLAS Ch. III deficiency, Code 09110 (rescue equipment).

scene_setup.context: C/O establishes serial vital-sign monitoring. Frequency depends on patient stability — every 5 minutes for critical, every 15 for stable.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Chief, vital sign monitoring every 5 minutes until helicopter arrival. Record on observation chart: time, pulse, BP, RR, SpO2, temperature, AVPU, pain score, urine output if catheterized. I want a trend, not snapshots. Over.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، مراقبة العلامات الحيوية كل 5 دقائق حتى وصول الهليكوبتر. سجل على شارت الملاحظة: الوقت، النبض، الضغط، التنفس، الأكسجين، الحرارة، AVPU، درجة الألم، إخراج البول إن كان قسطر. أريد منحنى، وليس لقطات. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — VITALS Q5MIN. CHART: TIME/P/BP/RR/SPO2/T/AVPU/PAIN. TREND, NOT SNAPSHOTS. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Chief, <break time="400ms"/> vital sign monitoring <break time="300ms"/> every five minutes <break time="300ms"/> until helicopter arrival. <break time="500ms"/> Record on observation chart: <break time="400ms"/> time, <break time="250ms"/> pulse, <break time="250ms"/> BP, <break time="250ms"/> respiratory rate, <break time="250ms"/> SpO2, <break time="250ms"/> temperature, <break time="250ms"/> AVPU, <break time="250ms"/> pain score, <break time="250ms"/> urine output if catheterized. <break time="500ms"/> I want a trend, <break time="300ms"/> not snapshots.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Build the COMPLETE vital-sign observation entry. Drag elements in correct order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ قيد العلامات الحيوية الكامل. رتّب العناصر.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Personal/emotional details belong in welfare follow-up, not the medical observation chart. Initials are LEGALLY required.

correct.text: Correct. Standard observation chart line. Initials are legally required — they identify who took the reading. Without initials, the entry is inadmissible in court and PSC review.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. سطر شارت ملاحظة قياسي. التوقيع/الأحرف الأولى مطلوبة قانونياً — تحدد من أخذ القراءة. بدونها، القيد غير مقبول في المحكمة ومراجعة PSC.

incorrect.text: Missing initials, missing critical parameter, or extras included. Charts are forensic documents.
incorrect.text_ar: أحرف أولى مفقودة، معيار حرج مفقود، أو إضافات. الشارتس وثائق جنائية / قانونية.

real_consequence.description: Trend reveals what snapshots hide. NHS UK studies extrapolated to maritime: continuous Q5min charting catches deterioration on average 22 minutes earlier than Q30 min charting.
real_consequence.psc_link: Incomplete observation charts → ISM Element 11 documentation finding + STCW competence flag.

scene_setup.context: C/O delivers a stability synthesis — not a list of numbers, a clinical judgment statement. Doctor needs the BOTTOM LINE for helicopter coordination.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Doctor, stability synthesis: patient is BORDERLINE STABLE. Vitals stabilized after splinting and warming — pulse held at 124, BP 105 over 68, RR 24, SpO2 95 percent, AVPU Alert, pain 6 of 10 with splint. No further deterioration since 08:30 UTC, but no improvement. Compensating, but reserve is limited. MEDEVAC strongly indicated within the hour. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، خلاصة الاستقرار: المريض على حافة الاستقرار. العلامات استقرت بعد التثبيت والتدفئة — النبض ثابت 124، الضغط 105/68، التنفس 24، الأكسجين 95٪، AVPU واعٍ، الألم 6/10 مع الجبيرة. لا تدهور إضافي منذ 08:30 UTC، لكن لا تحسن. يعوّض، لكن احتياطه محدود. MEDEVAC مطلوب بقوة خلال الساعة. تحويل.

interaction.question: Stability classification — patient with vitals stable for 20 minutes after intervention but in compensated shock with limited reserve. Best classification?
interaction.question_ar: تصنيف الاستقرار — مريض علاماته مستقرة 20 دقيقة بعد التدخل لكن في صدمة معوّضة باحتياط محدود. أفضل تصنيف؟

options.text: STABLE — no intervention needed
BORDERLINE STABLE / COMPENSATING — stable now, MEDEVAC strongly indicated before decompensation
UNSTABLE — actively deteriorating, immediate Mayday
CRITICAL — cardiac arrest imminent

correct.text: Correct. Three-tier classification: STABLE (vitals normal, intervention only) / BORDERLINE STABLE-COMPENSATING (vitals abnormal but holding, MEDEVAC priority) / UNSTABLE (vitals declining, immediate MEDEVAC, possibly Mayday). Knowing the tier prevents over- or under-escalation.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تصنيف ثلاثي: مستقر (علامات طبيعية، تدخل فقط) / حافة مستقر-معوّض (علامات غير طبيعية لكن ثابتة، MEDEVAC أولوية) / غير مستقر (علامات تتدهور، MEDEVAC فوري، ربما Mayday). معرفة المستوى تمنع التصعيد المبالغ أو المنقوص.

incorrect.text: Compensating shock is NOT stable — patient may decompensate suddenly. NOT critical — patient is still maintaining. The middle category captures reality.
incorrect.text_ar: الصدمة المعوضة ليست استقراراً — قد ينهار فجأة. ليست حرجة — لا يزال يحافظ. الفئة الوسطى تعكس الواقع.

real_consequence.description: Misclassifying a compensating patient as 'stable' delays MEDEVAC and may lead to cardiac arrest in transit. Misclassifying as 'critical' triggers Mayday and unnecessary aircraft launch — wastes USCG/MRCC resources.
real_consequence.psc_link: Wrong stability assessment → STCW VI/4-2 (Master/officer in charge of medical care) competence finding.

modules.module_objective: Master the decision threshold: when MEDEVAC is required, when medical advice is enough, how to formally request MEDEVAC, and the most common decision mistakes.

scene_setup.context: Master and Doctor agree on MEDEVAC. Master must articulate the criteria — for log, for crew training, and for any future review.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Doctor, my MEDEVAC indication: borderline-stable patient with internal blood loss, distance to definitive care over 12 hours by ship, on-board capability exhausted, deterioration risk high. Confirm helicopter dispatch. Over.
dialogue.arabic: دكتور، مؤشر MEDEVAC عندي: مريض حافة استقرار مع نزيف داخلي، المسافة للرعاية النهائية أكثر من 12 ساعة بالسفينة، القدرات على السفينة استُنفدت، احتمال التدهور عالٍ. أكد إرسال الهليكوبتر. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: DOCTOR — MEDEVAC INDICATION: BORDERLINE PT, INTERNAL BLEED, >12H TO CARE BY SHIP, ONBOARD MAXED, HIGH DECLINE RISK. CONFIRM HELI. OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Master, agreed. MEDEVAC authorized. Helicopter dispatched, ETA 35 minutes from your position. Confirm position, weather, and helideck readiness. Over.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، متفق. MEDEVAC معتمد. الهليكوبتر أُرسلت، الوصول 35 دقيقة من موقعك. أكد الموقع، الطقس، جاهزية الهبوط. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — AGREED. MEDEVAC AUTH. HELI ETA 35 MIN. CONFIRM POS/WX/HELIDECK. OVER.

interaction.question: Which combination of criteria justifies MEDEVAC by helicopter?
interaction.question_ar: أي تركيبة من المعايير تبرر MEDEVAC بالهليكوبتر؟

options.text: Patient has mild seasickness, vessel 1 hour from port
Time-critical condition + on-board capability exhausted + distance to shore care exceeds patient's tolerance window + helicopter operationally feasible
Patient prefers a helicopter
Master is tired and wants the patient off the ship

correct.text: Correct. The four MEDEVAC criteria (per IAMSAR Vol III + IMO MSC.1/Circ.1218): (1) Time-critical — patient cannot wait. (2) On-board care exhausted. (3) Distance/time to shore exceeds tolerance. (4) Helicopter feasible (range, weather, deck). All four needed.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. المعايير الأربعة لـ MEDEVAC (حسب IAMSAR Vol III + IMO MSC.1/Circ.1218): (1) حرجة الوقت — المريض لا ينتظر. (2) القدرات على السفينة استُنفدت. (3) المسافة/الوقت للبر يتجاوز قدرة المريض. (4) الهليكوبتر ممكنة (مدى، طقس، سطح). كلها مطلوبة.

incorrect.text: Option D is a CRITICAL mistake — abuse of MEDEVAC system is recorded, investigated, and may result in flag-state action and company billing for unnecessary aircraft launch (USD 30,000-150,000 per call).
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار D خطأ كارثي — إساءة استخدام نظام MEDEVAC تُسجل، تُحقق، وقد تُعرّض دولة العلم لإجراءات + فاتورة الشركة على إطلاق طائرة دون داعٍ (30-150 ألف دولار للنداء).

real_consequence.description: USCG 2020 review: 8% of merchant vessel MEDEVAC requests were assessed as unjustified post-event. 2 cases led to formal company warnings and operational fines.
real_consequence.psc_link: Repeated unjustified MEDEVAC = ISM Element 6 (Resources & Personnel) flag — competence audit.

scene_setup.context: Doctor educates the team — most cases at sea do NOT require MEDEVAC. About 80% of CIRM consultations are managed entirely on board with shore guidance.

dialogue.speaker: Shore Doctor
dialogue.english: Master, training point: about 80 percent of medical calls at sea are managed on board with advice only. MEDEVAC is the exception, not the default. Reserve it for time-critical cases.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، نقطة تدريب: حوالي 80٪ من النداءات الطبية في البحر تُدار على السفينة بالاستشارة فقط. MEDEVAC استثناء، وليس قاعدة. احفظه للحالات حرجة الوقت.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — TRAINING: 80% MANAGED ONBOARD WITH ADVICE. MEDEVAC = EXCEPTION.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Master, <break time="400ms"/> training point: <break time="500ms"/> about eighty percent of medical calls at sea <break time="300ms"/> are managed on board <break time="300ms"/> with advice only. <break time="500ms"/> MEDEVAC <break time="300ms"/> is the exception, <break time="300ms"/> not the default.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which case is BEST managed with Medical Advice ONLY (no MEDEVAC)?
interaction.question_ar: أي حالة تُدار بالاستشارة الطبية فقط (بدون MEDEVAC)؟

options.text: Crew with stable laceration on hand, suturing decision and antibiotic guidance, vessel 6 hours from port
Crew with crushing chest pain, sweating, radiating to left arm
Crew unconscious, irregular breathing
Crew with severe arterial bleeding from amputated finger

correct.text: Correct. Stable laceration is procedural — doctor guides suturing or steri-strips, antibiotic prophylaxis, dressing change schedule. Patient continues voyage. The other three are MEDEVAC-level.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الجرح المستقر إجرائي — الطبيب يوجه الخياطة أو steri-strips، المضاد الحيوي، جدول تغيير الضماد. المريض يكمل الرحلة. الثلاثة الأخرى من مستوى MEDEVAC.

incorrect.text: Cardiac, unconsciousness, and arterial bleed are red-flag conditions requiring evacuation, not just advice.
incorrect.text_ar: القلب، فقد الوعي، النزيف الشرياني هي حالات إنذار حمراء تتطلب إخلاء، وليس استشارة فقط.

real_consequence.description: CIRM Genoa data 2022: 8,400 consultations, of which only ~1,200 (14%) escalated to MEDEVAC. The rest were handled with shore guidance. Knowing the threshold saves resources and respects the patient's voyage.
real_consequence.psc_link: Demonstrated competence in onboard care = positive ISM audit indicator.

real_consequence.description: Standardized Pan-Pan Medico requests reduce SAR coordination time by ~25% (UK MCA + Falmouth MRCC data). Non-standard requests trigger repeat callbacks.

scene_setup.location: Master's office, post-event debrief, 14:00 UTC (after MEDEVAC complete)
scene_setup.context: Master debriefs the team. Six classic decision mistakes — known from MAIB/USCG/Tokyo MoU casualty reports — are reviewed.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Team — six decision mistakes that kill. One: delay in calling Master. Two: wrong call type. Three: under-reporting patient condition. Four: self-medicating without doctor authorization. Five: late escalation — sticking to Request Medical Advice when patient is decompensating. Six: false confidence — refusing MEDEVAC when offered. Memorize these. They are in every casualty report.
dialogue.arabic: الفريق — ستة أخطاء قرار قاتلة. واحد: تأخير استدعاء الكابتن. اثنان: نوع نداء خاطئ. ثلاثة: تقليل وصف حالة المريض. أربعة: علاج ذاتي بدون إذن الطبيب. خمسة: تصعيد متأخر — البقاء على Request Medical Advice مع تدهور المريض. ستة: ثقة كاذبة — رفض MEDEVAC عند عرضه. احفظوها. كلها في كل تقرير حادث.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

interaction.question: Which is the MOST DANGEROUS MEDEVAC-decision mistake — recorded in multiple maritime fatality reports?
interaction.question_ar: أي خطأ قرار MEDEVAC هو الأخطر — مسجل في تقارير وفيات بحرية متعددة؟

options.text: Late escalation — staying at Request Medical Advice while patient decompensates
Asking too many questions to the doctor
Logging vital signs every 5 minutes
Speaking slowly on the radio

correct.text: Correct. 'Late escalation' is the #1 documented decision error in maritime fatality cases (MAIB, BSU, USCG combined data). The pattern: Master holds at advice level for too long, hoping patient stabilizes; when finally escalating to MEDEVAC, the time window has closed.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. 'التصعيد المتأخر' هو الخطأ الأول الموثق في وفيات البحر (بيانات MAIB، BSU، USCG مجتمعة). النمط: الكابتن يبقى على مستوى الاستشارة طويلاً أملاً باستقرار المريض؛ وعند التصعيد أخيراً، تكون نافذة الإنقاذ أُغلقت.

incorrect.text: Asking, logging, and speaking clearly are GOOD practices, not mistakes. The killer is hesitation to escalate.
incorrect.text_ar: السؤال، التوثيق، والكلام الواضح ممارسات جيدة، وليست أخطاء. القاتل هو التردد في التصعيد.

real_consequence.description: Cross-MoU analysis 2015-2023: 'Late escalation' identified as primary causal factor in 14 documented at-sea fatalities. Average delay before escalation: 2-4 hours after first sign of decompensation.
real_consequence.psc_link: Pattern of late escalation in company → ISM Element 1.2.3 (safety culture) flag → expanded inspection.

modules.module_objective: Coordinate the final approach: continuous helicopter communication, ETA management, identification signals, pilot instructions, and disciplined VHF Channel 16 use.

interaction.question: Why does the helicopter pilot ALWAYS request a switch from Channel 16 to a working channel as soon as initial contact is made?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا يطلب طيار الهليكوبتر دائماً التحويل من القناة 16 إلى قناة عمل فور الاتصال الأولي؟

options.text: Channel 16 is reserved for distress and initial calling — extended operational dialogue must move to a working channel to keep Channel 16 clear
Channel 16 has bad audio quality
Pilot prefers other channels personally
Channel 16 only works at night

correct.text: Correct. SOLAS Ch. IV / IMO SMCP rule: Channel 16 is the international distress, safety, and CALLING frequency. Once contact is established, all working communication shifts to a designated working channel (commonly Ch. 06, 08, 67, 73, 77 for SAR/MEDEVAC). This keeps Ch. 16 clear for other distress calls.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. قاعدة SOLAS Ch. IV / IMO SMCP: القناة 16 للاستغاثة والسلامة والاتصال الأولي فقط. بعد إنشاء الاتصال، كل التواصل التشغيلي ينتقل إلى قناة عمل محددة (الشائع 06، 08، 67، 73، 77 لـ SAR/MEDEVAC). هذا يحفظ القناة 16 لنداءات أخرى.

incorrect.text: Channel discipline is regulatory, not aesthetic or personal. Holding extended traffic on Ch. 16 is a serious GMDSS violation.
incorrect.text_ar: انضباط القنوات تنظيمي، ليس شكلياً ولا شخصياً. الإطالة على القناة 16 مخالفة GMDSS جسيمة.

real_consequence.description: Ch. 16 blocking during emergency may prevent another nearby vessel from reporting its own distress. Coast Guard will issue formal warnings; repeated offenses → flag-state license action.
real_consequence.psc_link: GMDSS log review → SOLAS Ch. IV non-compliance, possible Paris MoU finding.

dialogue.english: RESCUE 193, ATLAS PIONEER. Patient ready in Neil Robertson stretcher at winching circle. Hookman in position. All loose items secured. Fire team standing by. Helideck ready. Confirmed. Over.
dialogue.arabic: RESCUE 193، ATLAS PIONEER. المريض جاهز في نقالة Neil Robertson عند دائرة الرفع. الـ hookman في موقعه. كل السائب مثبت. فريق الإطفاء على استعداد. السطح جاهز. مؤكد. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: RESCUE 193 — PT READY NEIL ROB STRETCHER — HOOKMAN OK — LOOSE OK — FIRE TEAM OK — DECK READY — CONFIRMED — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master (internal handheld VHF)
dialogue.english: All stations ATLAS PIONEER, helicopter ETA 4 minutes. Final positions. Bosun confirm hookman ready. Doctor confirm patient packaged. Over.
dialogue.arabic: كل المحطات ATLAS PIONEER، الهليكوبتر تصل خلال 4 دقائق. مواقع نهائية. بوصن أكد الـ hookman جاهز. شيف أكد المريض جاهز. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ALL STATIONS — HELI ETA 4 MIN — FINAL POSITIONS — BOSUN/CHIEF CONFIRM — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%" pitch="+1st">ATLAS PIONEER, <break time="300ms"/> RESCUE 193. <break time="500ms"/> ETA winching commencement <break time="300ms"/> four minutes. <break time="600ms"/> Confirm patient at winching circle, <break time="300ms"/> hookman in position, <break time="300ms"/> all loose items secured.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Helicopter announces winching ETA 4 minutes. The patient is still in the ship's hospital, not yet at the winching circle. What is your IMMEDIATE action as Master?
interaction.question_ar: الهليكوبتر تعلن ETA 4 دقائق. المريض ما زال في مشفى السفينة، لم ينقل بعد إلى دائرة الرفع. الإجراء الفوري كـ Master؟

options.text: Confirm 'all ready' to helicopter to avoid embarrassment
Inform helicopter HONESTLY: patient transfer in progress, request ETA extension by 5 minutes; mobilize stretcher team to move IMMEDIATELY
Tell helicopter to come back later
Try to move the patient by yourself

correct.text: Correct. NEVER lie to the pilot. Honest comms protect everyone. A 5-minute hold is acceptable; arriving over deck without patient ready is dangerous (helicopter low on fuel + crew exposed). Mobilize team in parallel — do not stop one to do the other.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. لا تكذب على الطيار. التواصل الصادق يحمي الجميع. تأخير 5 دقائق مقبول؛ الوصول فوق السطح بدون مريض جاهز خطر (وقود قليل + طاقم معرض). حرّك الفريق بالتوازي — لا توقف أحدهم للآخر.

incorrect.text: Option A is CRITICAL — false confirmation has caused real near-misses. Lying to a helicopter pilot during operations is a serious offense.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار A كارثي — التأكيد الكاذب سبّب حوادث وشيكة حقيقية. الكذب على طيار الهليكوبتر أثناء العمليات مخالفة جسيمة.

real_consequence.description: Honest ETA management is a core SAR principle. Deceptive 'all ready' calls have led to helicopters arriving over an unprepared deck — wasted fuel, increased risk, and in some cases, missions aborted entirely.
real_consequence.psc_link: False operational reporting in SAR coordination = ISM Element 1.2 (safety culture) major non-conformity.

scene_setup.context: 3rd Officer prepares identification signals. Pyrotechnic smoke signal indicates wind direction visually for the pilot AND confirms vessel identity. At night, helideck lighting + identification.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Omar, when helicopter is 2 NM, light orange or green smoke flare on the bridge wing, downwind side. Hold until pilot acknowledges visual.
dialogue.arabic: عمر، لما الهليكوبتر تكون على بعد 2 ميل، أشعل شعلة دخان برتقالية أو خضراء على جناح البرج، جهة عكس الريح. احتفظ بها حتى يؤكد الطيار الرؤية.
dialogue.radio_short: OMAR — HELI 2NM — ORANGE/GREEN SMOKE BRIDGE WING DOWNWIND — HOLD UNTIL PILOT VISUAL ACK.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: Master, smoke flare ready, downwind side starboard wing, will ignite at 2 NM call. Acknowledged.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الشعلة جاهزة، جهة عكس الريح على الجناح الأيمن، أشعلها عند نداء 2 ميل. مفهوم.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — SMOKE READY STBD WING DOWNWIND — IGNITE AT 2NM CALL — ACK.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Omar, <break time="400ms"/> when helicopter is two nautical miles, <break time="400ms"/> light orange or green smoke flare <break time="300ms"/> on the bridge wing, <break time="300ms"/> downwind side. <break time="500ms"/> Hold until pilot <break time="300ms"/> acknowledges visual.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Why is the smoke flare lit on the DOWNWIND side of the bridge?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا تُشعل شعلة الدخان على الجانب عكس الريح من البرج؟

options.text: It looks more dramatic
Smoke is carried clear of the vessel showing wind direction to the pilot AND keeping smoke clear of bridge personnel and helicopter approach path
Downwind side has better lighting
It is a personal preference

correct.text: Correct. Smoke on the downwind side flows away from the vessel, giving the pilot a clear visual indicator of TRUE wind direction at the deck (more accurate than ship anemometer for low-altitude approach), AND keeping the smoke from blinding bridge crew or entering the helicopter's intake.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الدخان على الجانب عكس الريح يتدفق بعيداً عن السفينة، يعطي الطيار مؤشراً بصرياً واضحاً لاتجاه الريح الحقيقية على السطح (أدق من مقياس السفينة للاقتراب المنخفض)، ويحفظ الدخان من إعمى طاقم البرج أو دخول مدخل الهليكوبتر.

incorrect.text: Smoke flare position is operational, not aesthetic. Wrong side = pilot misjudges wind direction.
incorrect.text_ar: موقع الشعلة تشغيلي، ليس شكلياً. الجانب الخطأ = الطيار يخطئ في تقدير اتجاه الريح.

real_consequence.description: Smoke signals at sea are documented in SOLAS Ch. III and IAMSAR Vol III. Improperly placed smoke can mislead pilots about wind direction, contributing to approach errors.
real_consequence.psc_link: Pyrotechnic signals expired or improperly stored → SOLAS Ch. III deficiency, Code 09114.

scene_setup.context: Once helicopter is on approach, the PILOT has tactical command of the operation in the air. Master commands the ship. Both must coordinate but the rule is: PILOT'S WORD IS LAW for aircraft-related instructions.

dialogue.speaker: Helicopter Pilot
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, RESCUE 193. Reduce speed to 6 knots. Adjust heading 5 degrees to port. Maintain new heading 070 once stable. Acknowledge.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، RESCUE 193. خفّف السرعة إلى 6 عقد. عدّل الاتجاه 5 درجات يساراً. حافظ على الاتجاه الجديد 070 بعد الاستقرار. أكد.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — RESCUE 193 — SPD 6KT — HDG -5° PORT — NEW HDG 070 STEADY — ACK.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: RESCUE 193, ATLAS PIONEER, acknowledged. Reducing to 6 knots, adjusting heading 5 to port, new heading 070. Will report when stable. Over.
dialogue.arabic: RESCUE 193، ATLAS PIONEER، مفهوم. أخفض إلى 6 عقد، أعدل الاتجاه 5 يساراً، الاتجاه الجديد 070. أبلغ عند الاستقرار. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: RESCUE 193 — ACK — REDUCING 6KT — TURN 5°P — NEW HDG 070 — REPORT STEADY — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master (internal)
dialogue.english: Helmsman, port 5. Engine room, slow ahead, target 6 knots. Helmsman repeat order.
dialogue.arabic: Helmsman، يسار 5. غرفة المحرك، بطيء أمام، الهدف 6 عقد. Helmsman كرر الأمر.
dialogue.radio_short: HELMSMAN — PORT 5. E/R SLOW AHEAD 6KT. HELMSMAN REPEAT.

dialogue.speaker: Helmsman
dialogue.english: Master, port 5, sir.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، يسار 5، يا سيدي.
dialogue.radio_short: MASTER — PORT 5 SIR.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">RESCUE 193, <break time="300ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER, <break time="300ms"/> acknowledged. <break time="500ms"/> Reducing to six knots, <break time="300ms"/> adjusting heading five to port, <break time="300ms"/> new heading zero-seven-zero. <break time="500ms"/> Will report when stable. <break time="400ms"/> Over.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Pilot orders 'turn 5 degrees to port' but you, as Master, see traffic 1 NM on the port bow. What do you do?
interaction.question_ar: الطيار يأمر بانعطاف 5 درجات يساراً لكنك ترى حركة على بعد 1 ميل على القوس الأيسر. ماذا تفعل؟

options.text: Execute the order without telling the pilot about the traffic
Inform the pilot IMMEDIATELY: 'Unable port turn — traffic 1 NM port bow. Suggest starboard turn or maintain heading.' Pilot will adjust
Refuse silently and continue current heading
Sound general alarm

correct.text: Correct. Master remains responsible for SHIP safety (COLREG, navigation). If a pilot's instruction conflicts with safe navigation, the Master MUST inform the pilot and propose alternatives. The pilot will adjust the approach. Silent compliance OR silent refusal both kill — speak up.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الكابتن يبقى مسؤولاً عن سلامة السفينة (COLREG، الملاحة). إذا تعارضت تعليمات الطيار مع الملاحة الآمنة، يجب على الكابتن إبلاغ الطيار واقتراح بدائل. الطيار سيعدّل. الامتثال الصامت أو الرفض الصامت كلاهما يقتل — تكلم.

incorrect.text: A and C are CRITICAL. Both end in collision with traffic. Bridge resource management requires open, immediate communication with the pilot.
incorrect.text_ar: A و C كارثيان. كلاهما ينتهي باصطدام. إدارة موارد البرج تتطلب تواصلاً مفتوحاً وفورياً مع الطيار.

real_consequence.description: MAIB 2016 case: Master executed pilot turn during MEDEVAC, narrowly missed a fishing vessel. Investigation: 'Master failed to challenge pilot's order despite obvious traffic conflict.' Master's certificate suspended.
real_consequence.psc_link: Bridge Resource Management failure → STCW VIII / ISM Element 6 finding.

scene_setup.context: Patient successfully transferred. Master closes the operation with proper VHF discipline — clearing Pan-Pan Medico, thanking responders, and reverting Channel 16 to normal listening watch.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: PAN-PAN MEDICO PAN-PAN MEDICO PAN-PAN MEDICO. All stations, all stations, all stations. This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER ATLAS PIONEER ATLAS PIONEER. PAN-PAN MEDICO traffic CANCELLED. Patient successfully transferred to RESCUE 193 helicopter at 10:02 UTC. Vessel resuming voyage. ATLAS PIONEER OUT.
dialogue.arabic: PAN-PAN MEDICO ×3. كل المحطات ×3. هذه ناقلة الحبوب ATLAS PIONEER ×3. حركة PAN-PAN MEDICO ملغاة. المريض نُقل بنجاح إلى الهليكوبتر RESCUE 193 الساعة 10:02 UTC. السفينة تستأنف الرحلة. ATLAS PIONEER OUT.
dialogue.radio_short: PAN-PAN MEDICO x3 — ALL STATIONS x3 — ATLAS PIONEER x3 — PAN-PAN MEDICO CANCELLED — PT TRANSFERRED 10:02 UTC TO RESCUE 193 — RESUMING VOYAGE — ATLAS PIONEER OUT.

dialogue.speaker: MRCC Operator
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, MRCC, acknowledged. PAN-PAN MEDICO closed at 10:08 UTC. Thank you for professional cooperation. MRCC out.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، MRCC، مفهوم. PAN-PAN MEDICO أُغلقت الساعة 10:08 UTC. شكراً للتعاون المهني. MRCC out.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — MRCC ACK — CLOSED 10:08 UTC — THANKS — MRCC OUT.

voice_script.background_fx: VHF light static, calmer tone post-event
voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">PAN-PAN MEDICO <break time="300ms"/> PAN-PAN MEDICO <break time="300ms"/> PAN-PAN MEDICO. <break time="600ms"/> All stations, <break time="250ms"/> all stations, <break time="250ms"/> all stations. <break time="600ms"/> This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER, <break time="400ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER, <break time="400ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER. <break time="600ms"/> PAN-PAN MEDICO traffic CANCELLED. <break time="500ms"/> Patient successfully transferred to RESCUE 193 helicopter <break time="300ms"/> at one-zero-zero-two UTC. <break time="500ms"/> Vessel resuming voyage. <break time="500ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER OUT.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Build the FORMAL Pan-Pan Medico CANCELLATION call for VHF Channel 16. Drag elements in correct order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ نداء إلغاء PAN-PAN MEDICO الرسمي لـ VHF القناة 16. رتّب.
elements_pool: This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER (×3)
Patient successfully transferred to RESCUE 193 at 10:02 UTC.
Thanks for the great service guys!
correct_sequence: This is bulk carrier ATLAS PIONEER (×3)
Patient successfully transferred to RESCUE 193 at 10:02 UTC.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Cancellation must be formal and brief. Personal thanks/casual chat = inappropriate on Ch. 16.

correct.text: Correct. Formal Pan-Pan Medico cancellation = procedural × 3, all stations × 3, vessel ID × 3, CANCELLED statement, brief outcome, OUT. This closes the urgency frequency tag for all listening stations worldwide.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. إلغاء PAN-PAN MEDICO الرسمي = إجرائية × 3، كل المحطات × 3، تعريف السفينة × 3، بيان الإلغاء، نتيجة موجزة، OUT. هذا يغلق علامة العجالة لكل المحطات المستمعة عالمياً.

incorrect.text: Order broken or non-procedural extras. Casual closing language is improper on Ch. 16. Use formal closure and shift personal communications elsewhere.
incorrect.text_ar: الترتيب مكسور أو إضافات غير إجرائية. اللغة العامية غير مناسبة على القناة 16. استخدم الإغلاق الرسمي وحوّل التواصل الشخصي مكان آخر.

real_consequence.description: Failure to formally close Pan-Pan Medico can leave urgency-status active for hours, blocking other stations. ITU and IMO require explicit cancellation. Recorded GMDSS logs are reviewed in PSC and casualty inquiries.
real_consequence.psc_link: Improper VHF/GMDSS procedure → SOLAS Ch. IV non-compliance, possible Paris MoU finding.

modules.module_objective: Deliver precise navigational and meteorological data: position by GPS/ECDIS, wind, visibility, sea state, and helicopter suitability assessment.

scene_setup.context: MRCC requires position in degrees/minutes/decimal-minutes, WGS-84 datum. Format errors cost the helicopter precious time.

dialogue.speaker: MRCC Operator
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, MRCC. Confirm your position in degrees, minutes, and decimal minutes — datum WGS-84. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، MRCC. أكد موقعك بالدرجات والدقائق وكسور الدقائق — مرجع WGS-84. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — MRCC — POSITION DEG/MIN/DEC — WGS-84 — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: MRCC, ATLAS PIONEER. Position five-one degrees two-four decimal three-eight minutes North, zero-zero-two degrees one-eight decimal two-five minutes East. Datum WGS-84. GPS confirmed by ECDIS. Over.
dialogue.arabic: MRCC، ATLAS PIONEER. الموقع 51 درجة 24.38 دقيقة شمال، 002 درجة 18.25 دقيقة شرق. المرجع WGS-84. GPS مؤكد بـ ECDIS. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MRCC — ATLAS PIONEER — POS 51-24.38N 002-18.25E — WGS-84 — GPS/ECDIS CONFIRMED — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: MRCC Operator
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, MRCC, position copied 51 degrees 24 decimal 38 minutes North, 002 degrees 18 decimal 25 minutes East. Confirm — affirmative or negative? Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، MRCC. سجلت الموقع 51-24.38 شمال، 002-18.25 شرق. أكد — إيجابي أم سلبي؟ تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — MRCC COPIED 51-24.38N 002-18.25E — CONFIRM AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: MRCC, ATLAS PIONEER, AFFIRMATIVE. Position correct. Over.
dialogue.arabic: MRCC، ATLAS PIONEER، إيجابي. الموقع صحيح. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: MRCC — AFFIRMATIVE — POS CORRECT — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="86%">MRCC, <break time="300ms"/> ATLAS PIONEER. <break time="500ms"/> Position <break time="400ms"/> five-one degrees <break time="250ms"/> two-four decimal three-eight minutes North, <break time="500ms"/> zero-zero-two degrees <break time="250ms"/> one-eight decimal two-five minutes East. <break time="600ms"/> Datum WGS-eight-four. <break time="500ms"/> GPS confirmed by ECDIS. <break time="400ms"/> Over.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Which position format is the IMO/IAMSAR-preferred standard for SAR/MEDEVAC reporting?
interaction.question_ar: أي تنسيق موقع هو المعتمد لدى IMO/IAMSAR في تقارير SAR/MEDEVAC؟

options.text: Decimal degrees only (e.g., 51.4063°N, 2.3042°E)
Degrees, minutes, decimal minutes (e.g., 51°24.38'N, 002°18.25'E) — datum WGS-84
Degrees, minutes, seconds (e.g., 51°24'23"N, 002°18'15"E)
Approximate landmark description (e.g., near a buoy)

correct.text: Correct. IAMSAR Vol III standard: degrees + minutes + decimal minutes, with WGS-84 datum. This matches helicopter navigation systems and SAR coordination tools. Decimal degrees and degrees-minutes-seconds are valid but not the SAR standard. Landmark approximation at sea is dangerous.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. معيار IAMSAR Vol III: درجات + دقائق + كسور دقائق، مع مرجع WGS-84. هذا يطابق أنظمة الملاحة في الهليكوبتر وأدوات التنسيق. الكسور العشرية والثواني مقبولة لكنها ليست المعيار. التقريب بالعلامات الأرضية في البحر خطر.

incorrect.text: Option D is a CRITICAL mistake — landmark description in open sea is unusable for helicopter pilots. Format mismatches cause real navigation errors and time loss.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار D خطأ كارثي — وصف العلامات في البحر المفتوح غير مفيد لطياري الهليكوبتر. عدم توافق التنسيق يسبب أخطاء ملاحية حقيقية وفقد وقت.

real_consequence.description: USCG MEDEVAC operations data: position-format errors add an average of 7-12 minutes to helicopter intercept time. In a 35-minute ETA scenario, that is one-third of the response window.
real_consequence.psc_link: GMDSS log with non-standard position formats → SOLAS Ch. IV / IMO SMCP non-compliance finding.

scene_setup.context: Master cross-checks position from primary GPS, secondary GPS, and ECDIS. Single-source position is unacceptable for MEDEVAC — redundancy is non-negotiable.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Omar, I want THREE position confirmations before next transmission. Primary GPS, secondary GPS, ECDIS plot. Cross-check.
dialogue.arabic: عمر، أريد ثلاث تأكيدات للموقع قبل الإرسال القادم. GPS أساسي، GPS احتياطي، الموقع على ECDIS. قارنهم.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A

dialogue.speaker: 3rd Officer
dialogue.english: Master, primary GPS reads 51-24.38N 002-18.25E. Secondary GPS reads 51-24.38N 002-18.24E. ECDIS plot 51-24.38N 002-18.25E. Maximum discrepancy 0.01 minute, well within tolerance. Position confirmed.
dialogue.arabic: كابتن، الـ GPS الأساسي 51-24.38N 002-18.25E. الـ GPS الاحتياطي 51-24.38N 002-18.24E. ECDIS 51-24.38N 002-18.25E. أقصى فرق 0.01 دقيقة، ضمن النطاق. الموقع مؤكد.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Omar, <break time="400ms"/> I want THREE position confirmations <break time="300ms"/> before next transmission. <break time="500ms"/> Primary GPS, <break time="300ms"/> secondary GPS, <break time="300ms"/> ECDIS plot. <break time="500ms"/> Cross-check.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Why is single-source position UNACCEPTABLE during MEDEVAC reporting?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا الموقع من مصدر واحد غير مقبول في تقارير MEDEVAC؟

options.text: GPS spoofing, satellite outage, or display error can give a confidently wrong position. Cross-check protects the helicopter and patient.
It is faster to use only one source
MRCC prefers single source
Multiple sources confuse the helicopter

correct.text: Correct. GPS spoofing has been documented in multiple regions (Black Sea, Gulf of Oman, Eastern Mediterranean). Satellite outages happen. A confidently wrong position sends the helicopter to empty water. Cross-check primary GPS + secondary GPS + ECDIS + DR position from last known fix. ECDIS does NOT count as a separate source if it's fed from the same GPS — verify it is on independent input.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تشويش GPS موثق في عدة مناطق (البحر الأسود، خليج عُمان، شرق المتوسط). الانقطاعات تحدث. موقع خاطئ بثقة يرسل الهليكوبتر إلى ماء فارغ. اعمل cross-check بين GPS أساسي + احتياطي + ECDIS + DR من آخر fix. ECDIS لا يُعد مصدراً مستقلاً إن كان يُغذى من نفس GPS — تحقق.

incorrect.text: Speed without cross-check is false economy. MRCC ALWAYS prefers verified position. Multiple sources clarify, not confuse, when properly compared.
incorrect.text_ar: السرعة بدون cross-check اقتصاد كاذب. MRCC دائماً يفضل الموقع المؤكد. المصادر المتعددة توضح، لا تُربك، عند المقارنة الصحيحة.

real_consequence.description: Documented GPS spoofing in Black Sea (2017) sent multiple ships to false positions hundreds of NM off track. In a MEDEVAC, this could mean helicopter running out of fuel before locating vessel.
real_consequence.psc_link: Failure to maintain redundant navigation aids → SOLAS Ch. V Reg. 19 deficiency.

scene_setup.context: Helicopter pilot needs RELATIVE WIND on deck — not just true wind. The ship's heading + speed creates apparent wind that can exceed safe winching limits.

dialogue.speaker: Helicopter Pilot (via MRCC)
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, RESCUE 193. Report true wind, relative wind on deck, gusts, and your current heading and speed. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، RESCUE 193. أبلغني الريح الحقيقية، الريح النسبية على السطح، الزخات، اتجاهك وسرعتك الحالية. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — RESCUE 193 — TRUE WIND / REL WIND / GUSTS / HDG / SPD — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: RESCUE 193, ATLAS PIONEER. True wind 220 degrees, 18 knots, gusting 24. Vessel heading 095, speed 12 knots. Apparent relative wind on deck approximately 145 degrees relative, 25 knots. We can adjust heading and speed for your approach — request your preferred relative wind. Over.
dialogue.arabic: RESCUE 193، ATLAS PIONEER. الريح الحقيقية 220 درجة، 18 عقدة، زخات 24. السفينة الاتجاه 095، السرعة 12 عقدة. الريح النسبية الظاهرة على السطح تقريباً 145 نسبية، 25 عقدة. نقدر نعدل الاتجاه والسرعة — اطلب الريح النسبية المفضلة. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: RESCUE 193 — TRUE 220/18 G24 — HDG 095 SPD 12 — APP REL 145°/25KT — CAN ADJUST — REQUEST PREFERRED REL WIND — OVER.

dialogue.speaker: Helicopter Pilot
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, RESCUE 193. Request relative wind 030 degrees on port bow, 20 to 30 knots steady. Adjust heading and speed accordingly. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، RESCUE 193. اطلب الريح النسبية 030 على القوس الأيسر، 20-30 عقدة ثابتة. عدّل الاتجاه والسرعة. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — REQUEST REL 030° PORT BOW, 20-30 KT STEADY — ADJUST HDG/SPD — OVER.

voice_script.background_fx: VHF static + faint helicopter rotor in pilot transmission

interaction.question: Helicopter pilot typically requests relative wind on the port bow at what relative bearing for SAFEST winching approach?
interaction.question_ar: طيار الهليكوبتر عادة يطلب الريح النسبية على القوس الأيسر بأي اتجاه نسبي لأكثر اقتراب آمن للرفع؟

options.text: Dead astern (180° relative)
Approximately 030° relative on port bow (range typically 020°–045°), wind speed 15–30 knots steady
Directly on the bow (000° relative)
From any direction, doesn't matter

correct.text: Correct. The standard winching approach is from the port quarter to allow the pilot (sitting on the right) to maintain visual contact with the deck while the wind clears rotor downwash and exhaust away from the winch crew. 030° relative on the port bow is the typical request — your specific helicopter unit may request a slightly different bearing, always confirm. Wind too low = unstable hover; too high = excessive pitch. Steady wind matters more than perfect direction.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. اقتراب الرفع القياسي من الربع الأيسر ليحافظ الطيار (الجالس على اليمين) على رؤية السطح، مع إبعاد تيار الهواء والعادم عن طاقم الرفع. 030 نسبية على القوس الأيسر هو الطلب النموذجي — قد يطلب طاقمك زاوية مختلفة قليلاً، تأكد دائماً. ريح ضعيفة = تحوم غير مستقر؛ قوية = ميل مفرط. ثبات الريح أهم من الاتجاه المثالي.

incorrect.text: Wind direction matters CRITICALLY for helicopter safety. Wrong relative wind can cause aircraft to enter vortex ring state, deck contact, or rotor strike on cargo gear.
incorrect.text_ar: اتجاه الريح حرج لسلامة الهليكوبتر. الاتجاه الخاطئ قد يدخل الطائرة في vortex ring state، يصطدم بالسطح، أو رفرف الدوار يضرب رافعات البضاعة.

real_consequence.description: USCG Helicopter Operations Manual + IAMSAR Vol III: improper relative wind during shipboard winching has been a contributing factor in multiple maritime helicopter incidents. Master must know this, not just the pilot.
real_consequence.psc_link: Crew untrained in helicopter ops procedures → STCW VI/2 (advanced firefighting / specialist training) and ISM Element 6 finding.

scene_setup.context: Visibility is reported in nautical miles, with cloud base in feet. Both affect helicopter approach decision.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: RESCUE 193, ATLAS PIONEER. Visibility 8 nautical miles, no precipitation. Cloud base estimated 2,500 feet, scattered. Sea state 4 — moderate. Swell from southwest 2 meters. Sea surface temperature 14 Celsius. Air temperature 16 Celsius. No icing. Over.
dialogue.arabic: RESCUE 193، ATLAS PIONEER. الرؤية 8 ميل بحري، لا أمطار. قاعدة السحب تقريباً 2500 قدم، متفرقة. حالة البحر 4 — متوسطة. الموج من SW ارتفاع 2 متر. حرارة سطح البحر 14°. حرارة الجو 16°. لا تجمد. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: RESCUE 193 — VIS 8NM, NO PCPN. CLD 2500FT SCT. SEA 4. SWELL SW 2M. SST 14C. AIR 16C. NO ICING. OVER.

interaction.question: Build the COMPLETE weather report block for helicopter coordination. Drag in correct order.
interaction.question_ar: ابنِ بلوك تقرير الطقس الكامل لتنسيق الهليكوبتر. رتّب.
interaction.distractor_explanation: Hospitality items go AFTER the helicopter has accepted the approach, not in the operational weather block.

correct.text: Correct. Standard weather block order: Visibility → Cloud base → Sea state → Swell → Temperatures → Icing. This matches helicopter pre-approach checklist.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. ترتيب البلوك القياسي: الرؤية → قاعدة السحب → حالة البحر → الموج → الحرارة → التجمد. مطابق للقائمة المرجعية للهليكوبتر.

incorrect.text: Order broken or non-operational extras. Helicopter pre-approach decisions depend on this block being complete and standard.
incorrect.text_ar: الترتيب مكسور أو إضافات غير تشغيلية. قرارات ما قبل الاقتراب تعتمد على اكتمال هذا البلوك وانتظامه.

real_consequence.description: Incomplete weather data has caused helicopter approach aborts mid-transit. Each abort = 20-40 min lost, fuel burned, patient deteriorating. Some MEDEVACs have been cancelled due to inability to assess deck conditions.
real_consequence.psc_link: Inadequate weather observation log → SOLAS Ch. V Reg. 5 (meteorological services) finding.

scene_setup.context: Master makes the final go/no-go assessment. Helicopter pilot has authority over the aircraft, but Master has authority over the ship — both must agree.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Khaled, suitability summary for log. Wind, sea, visibility within helicopter operating limits. Bulk carrier hatch covers clear of obstructions on number 4 hold area, designated winching zone. Crew briefed. Fire team ready. Patient packaged. My assessment: GO.
dialogue.arabic: خالد، ملخص الملاءمة للسجل. الريح والبحر والرؤية ضمن حدود الهليكوبتر. أغطية العنابر خالية من العوائق على منطقة العنبر رقم 4، منطقة الرفع المعينة. الطاقم متلقي البريفنغ. فريق الإطفاء جاهز. المريض جاهز للنقل. تقييمي: GO.
dialogue.radio_short: N/A — internal command

dialogue.speaker: Helicopter Pilot
dialogue.english: ATLAS PIONEER, RESCUE 193. Confirm GO from Master. My assessment also GO. Approach in 12 minutes. Stand by Channel 16. Over.
dialogue.arabic: ATLAS PIONEER، RESCUE 193. أكدت GO من الكابتن. تقييمي أيضاً GO. الاقتراب خلال 12 دقيقة. ابق على القناة 16. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: ATLAS PIONEER — RESCUE 193 — BOTH GO — APPROACH 12 MIN — STAND BY CH16 — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">My assessment: <break time="500ms"/> GO.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Wind suddenly increases to 45 knots gusting 60 just before helicopter arrival. Patient is stable. What is the CORRECT decision?
interaction.question_ar: الريح ارتفعت فجأة إلى 45 عقدة بزخات 60 قبل وصول الهليكوبتر. المريض مستقر. القرار الصحيح؟

options.text: Continue MEDEVAC anyway — patient must be evacuated
Inform helicopter pilot immediately, declare conditions out of limits, ABORT and reschedule. Patient is stable — no justification for unsafe winching.
Hide the wind data so helicopter doesn't abort
Increase ship speed to 25 knots

correct.text: Correct. Above approximately 40-45 knots steady wind with significant gusting, most rescue helicopters cannot winch safely. The pilot has final authority on go/no-go for the aircraft. If patient is stable, ABORT is the correct decision. Reschedule when conditions improve, OR consider port diversion if patient deteriorates.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. فوق 40-45 عقدة ريح ثابتة مع زخات قوية، معظم هليكوبترات الإنقاذ لا تستطيع الرفع بأمان. الطيار له القرار النهائي للطائرة. إذا المريض مستقر، الإلغاء هو القرار الصحيح. إعادة الجدولة أو التحويل لميناء إذا تدهور المريض.

incorrect.text: Options A and C are CRITICAL. Continuing in unsafe wind = aircraft loss + patient drowning + winch crew fatality. Hiding weather data is criminal — investigated as deliberate endangerment.
incorrect.text_ar: الخياران A و C كارثيان. الاستمرار في ريح غير آمنة = فقد الطائرة + غرق المريض + وفاة طاقم الرفع. إخفاء بيانات الطقس جريمة — تُحقق كتعريض متعمد للخطر.

real_consequence.description: Multiple maritime helicopter accidents during winching attempts in marginal weather are documented in SAR / MAIB / NTSB reports. Aborting and rescheduling is always preferable to attempting unsafe winching.
real_consequence.psc_link: False weather reporting in support of unsafe operation → ISM Element 1.2 (safety culture) major non-conformity, possible criminal referral.

modules.module_objective: Prepare the vessel and the winching area to ICS-recognized standard: clear deck, secure loose objects, brief crew, position fire team, manage course/speed during winching.

scene_setup.location: Number 4 hatch cover area (designated winching zone), 09:24 UTC
scene_setup.context: Bulk carriers without certified helideck use a CLEAR DECK area — typically a hatch cover. ICS Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations defines a 5m × 5m clear winching circle, with 30m × 30m approach clearance.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (handheld VHF)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief on Hatch 4. Winching circle marked with high-visibility cones. Diameter 6 meters, clear of obstructions. Approach corridor verified clear 30 meters surrounding. Wind sock erected port side. No personnel inside circle except designated hookman. Over.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، Chief على العنبر 4. دائرة الرفع معلمة بمخاريط عاكسة. القطر 6 متر، خالية من العوائق. ممر الاقتراب 30 متر محيطة. قمصان الريح منصوب على اليسار. لا أحد داخل الدائرة عدا الـ hookman المعين. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF — HATCH 4 — WINCH CIRCLE 6M MARKED, CLEAR. APPROACH 30M CLEAR. WINDSOCK PORT. HOOKMAN ONLY. OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="90%">Bridge, <break time="300ms"/> Chief on Hatch 4. <break time="500ms"/> Winching circle marked <break time="250ms"/> with high-visibility cones. <break time="400ms"/> Diameter six meters, <break time="300ms"/> clear of obstructions. <break time="500ms"/> Approach corridor verified clear <break time="250ms"/> thirty meters surrounding. <break time="500ms"/> Wind sock erected port side. <break time="400ms"/> No personnel inside circle <break time="250ms"/> except designated hookman.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: What is the MINIMUM clear winching circle diameter recommended by ICS Guide to Helicopter/Ship Operations for a non-helideck winching area?
interaction.question_ar: ما الحد الأدنى لقطر دائرة الرفع الموصى به من ICS لمنطقة رفع بدون سطح هبوط معتمد؟

options.text: 1 meter
5 meters minimum (winching circle), with 30m × 30m surrounding obstacle-free zone
20 meters
No minimum specified

correct.text: Correct. ICS standard: 5m winching circle (clear deck), within a 30m × 30m clear zone (no rigging, no antennas, no loose gear). On bulk carriers, the most common location is a hatch cover. Crew must mark this in advance — not during emergency.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. معيار ICS: دائرة رفع 5 متر (سطح خالٍ)، ضمن منطقة 30×30 متر خالية (لا حبال، لا هوائيات، لا معدات سائبة). على الـ Bulk Carriers، الموقع الشائع هو غطاء عنبر. الطاقم يعلمها مسبقاً — وليس أثناء الطارئ.

incorrect.text: 1m is dangerously small — guarantees rotor strike. Larger than required wastes preparation time. Standards exist for safety reasons.
incorrect.text_ar: 1 متر خطر — يضمن اصطدام الدوار. أكبر من اللازم يهدر وقت التحضير. المعايير موجودة لأسباب سلامة.

real_consequence.description: Helicopter rotor strikes on shipboard structures — antennas, cranes, ventilators — are documented in maritime SAR incident reports. ICS standard exists specifically to prevent these.
real_consequence.psc_link: Helicopter operating area not marked / not maintained → ISM + SOLAS Ch. III deficiency (rescue equipment readiness).

scene_setup.context: Final obstacle sweep. Bulk carriers have many semi-permanent items that must be temporarily moved or secured.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Bosun, final obstacle sweep checklist. One — all loose dunnage stowed. Two — mooring lines on hatch coaming secured below. Three — fire hoses ready but not deployed in winching circle. Four — radio antennas verified clear of approach corridor. Five — accommodation ladder housed. Six — derrick or crane booms cradled and secured. Confirm each.
dialogue.arabic: بوصن، قائمة فحص العوائق النهائية. واحد — كل الـ dunnage السائب محفوظ. اثنان — حبال الربط على إطار العنبر مربوطة تحت. ثلاثة — خراطيم الإطفاء جاهزة لكن ليست داخل دائرة الرفع. أربعة — هوائيات الراديو مؤكدة خارج ممر الاقتراب. خمسة — سلم السكن مرفوع. ستة — أذرع الرافعة مطوية ومثبتة. أكد كل واحدة.
dialogue.radio_short: BOSUN — OBSTACLE CHECKLIST: 1 DUNNAGE STOWED. 2 LINES SECURE. 3 HOSES READY OFF CIRCLE. 4 ANTENNAS CLEAR. 5 LADDER HOUSED. 6 BOOMS CRADLED. CONFIRM EACH.

dialogue.speaker: Bosun
dialogue.english: Chief, all six confirmed. Hatch 4 area clear and ready. Over.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، الست كلها مؤكدة. منطقة العنبر 4 خالية وجاهزة. تحويل.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — ALL 6 CONFIRMED — HATCH 4 CLEAR — OVER.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Bosun, <break time="400ms"/> final obstacle sweep checklist. <break time="600ms"/> One <break time="400ms"/> — all loose dunnage stowed. <break time="500ms"/> Two <break time="400ms"/> — mooring lines on hatch coaming secured below. <break time="500ms"/> Three <break time="400ms"/> — fire hoses ready but not deployed in winching circle. <break time="500ms"/> Four <break time="400ms"/> — radio antennas verified clear of approach corridor. <break time="500ms"/> Five <break time="400ms"/> — accommodation ladder housed. <break time="500ms"/> Six <break time="400ms"/> — derrick or crane booms cradled and secured.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Why must fire hoses be READY but NOT deployed inside the winching circle before helicopter approach?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا يجب أن تكون خراطيم الإطفاء جاهزة لكن غير منشورة داخل دائرة الرفع قبل الاقتراب؟

options.text: Hoses look untidy
Loose hoses can be lifted by rotor downwash and become projectiles into rotor blades; must be ready for immediate deployment in fire emergency only
Water in hoses is too heavy
Hoses can be deployed inside the circle anytime

correct.text: Correct. Helicopter rotor downwash exceeds 60-80 knots near the surface. Anything not secured — hose, line, plastic, paper, hat — becomes a projectile risking rotor strike. Hoses must be on standby (charged, manned) BUT outside the winching circle, deployable in seconds if needed.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. تيار الهواء من دوار الهليكوبتر يتجاوز 60-80 عقدة قرب السطح. أي شيء غير مثبت — خرطوم، حبل، بلاستيك، ورق، قبعة — يصبح مقذوفاً يخاطر بضرب الدوار. الخراطيم على استعداد (مشحونة، مع طاقم) لكن خارج دائرة الرفع، قابلة للنشر خلال ثوانٍ.

incorrect.text: Option D is CRITICAL — deployed hoses inside the winching circle have caused near-incidents in maritime SAR operations. Always READY and OUTSIDE.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار D كارثي — الخراطيم المنشورة داخل دائرة الرفع سببت حوادث وشيكة في عمليات الإنقاذ. دائماً جاهزة وخارج الدائرة.

real_consequence.description: MAIB and USCG case files contain incidents of unsecured items lifted by rotor downwash striking aircraft. Each requires inspection grounding of the helicopter and, in worst cases, mission failure.
real_consequence.psc_link: Loose items on deck during emergency drill = ISM Element 7 + SOLAS finding.

scene_setup.context: C/O personally walks the deck for final visual sweep. Anything loose within ~50 meters of the winching zone is a risk.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (radio to bridge)
dialogue.english: Bridge, Chief, deck walk complete. Loose items secured: lashing chains, paint cans, rope coils, plastic sheeting, hard hats. Crew personal effects below decks. Hatch covers fully closed. Cargo hold ventilators sealed. Deck inspected vacant of personnel except designated MEDEVAC team. Confirm Master.
dialogue.arabic: البرج، Chief، جولة السطح اكتملت. مثبت: سلاسل الربط، علب الدهان، لفائف الحبال، أغشية البلاستيك، الخوذات. متاع الطاقم تحت السطح. أغطية العنابر مغلقة كلياً. ventilators العنابر مسدودة. السطح خالٍ من الأفراد عدا فريق MEDEVAC المعين. أكد كابتن.
dialogue.radio_short: BRIDGE — CHIEF — DECK WALK DONE. LASHINGS/CANS/ROPES/PLASTIC/HATS SECURED. CREW BELOW. HATCHES CLOSED. VENTS SEALED. ONLY MEDEVAC TEAM ON DECK. CONFIRM MASTER.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Confirmed Chief. Deck status logged. Stand by for helicopter approach.
dialogue.arabic: مؤكد Chief. حالة السطح مسجلة. استعد لاقتراب الهليكوبتر.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — CONFIRMED. DECK STATUS LOGGED. STAND BY APPROACH.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Bridge, <break time="300ms"/> Chief, <break time="300ms"/> deck walk complete. <break time="500ms"/> Loose items secured: <break time="400ms"/> lashing chains, <break time="250ms"/> paint cans, <break time="250ms"/> rope coils, <break time="250ms"/> plastic sheeting, <break time="250ms"/> hard hats. <break time="500ms"/> Crew personal effects below decks. <break time="400ms"/> Hatch covers fully closed. <break time="400ms"/> Cargo hold ventilators sealed.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: 5 minutes before helicopter arrival, you spot a loose 20-liter plastic drum near the winching zone. What is the CORRECT action?
interaction.question_ar: قبل 5 دقائق من وصول الهليكوبتر تلاحظ برميل بلاستيك 20 لتر سائباً قرب منطقة الرفع. الإجراء الصحيح؟

options.text: Ignore — too late to fix
Send one crew member to remove or lash it immediately, confirm complete to Bridge, log time
Throw it overboard quickly
Hope the rotor downwash blows it overboard

correct.text: Correct. Loose objects can become rotor-strike projectiles. ALWAYS remove or secure, even at the last moment. One crew member, fast action, confirm to bridge, log it. Throwing overboard is pollution — MARPOL violation. Hoping is criminal negligence.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الأجسام السائبة قد تصبح مقذوفات تضرب الدوار. دائماً أزل أو ربط، حتى في اللحظة الأخيرة. فرد طاقم، إجراء سريع، تأكيد للبرج، توثيق. الرمي في البحر تلوث — مخالفة MARPOL. الرجاء إهمال جنائي.

incorrect.text: Options A and D are CRITICAL. Throwing overboard violates MARPOL Annex V. The only correct action is immediate securing.
incorrect.text_ar: الخياران A و D كارثيان. الرمي في البحر مخالفة MARPOL Annex V. الإجراء الوحيد الصحيح هو التثبيت الفوري.

real_consequence.description: Both rotor strike and overboard discharge during emergency operations are reported in MoU expanded inspections. The right action is the lawful, safety-conscious one — even under time pressure.
real_consequence.psc_link: MARPOL Annex V violation = potential detention. Rotor strike investigation = ISM major non-conformity.

scene_setup.context: Fire team is positioned per ICS standard: charged hose ready, foam tender available, fully kitted in fire-fighting outfit, one team member observing winching with handheld radio.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer
dialogue.english: Fire team — positions. Two crew with charged 1.5-inch hose, fog spray, 15 meters forward of winching circle, downwind side. Foam extinguisher 9-liter on standby. Two crew in full fire-fighting outfit including SCBA. One observer with handheld VHF Channel 16. Acknowledge each station.
dialogue.arabic: فريق الإطفاء — مواقع. اثنان مع خرطوم 1.5 بوصة مشحون، رش ضباب، 15 متر أمام دائرة الرفع، جهة عكس الريح. طفاية رغوة 9 لتر احتياط. اثنان بزي إطفاء كامل + SCBA. مراقب واحد مع VHF محمول قناة 16. أكد كل موقع.
dialogue.radio_short: FIRE TEAM — STATIONS. 2x HOSE 1.5" CHARGED, 15M FWD, DOWNWIND. FOAM 9L. 2x FF KIT + SCBA. 1 OBSERVER VHF CH16. ACK ALL.

voice_script.ssml: <speak><prosody rate="88%">Fire team <break time="400ms"/> — positions. <break time="500ms"/> Two crew with charged one-point-five-inch hose, <break time="300ms"/> fog spray, <break time="300ms"/> fifteen meters forward of winching circle, <break time="300ms"/> downwind side. <break time="500ms"/> Foam extinguisher nine-liter on standby. <break time="500ms"/> Two crew in full fire-fighting outfit <break time="300ms"/> including SCBA. <break time="500ms"/> One observer <break time="300ms"/> with handheld VHF Channel one-six.</prosody></speak>

interaction.question: Why must the fire team be positioned UPWIND or DOWNWIND of the winching circle, NOT directly under the helicopter?
interaction.question_ar: لماذا يقف فريق الإطفاء عكس الريح أو مع الريح من دائرة الرفع، وليس تحت الهليكوبتر مباشرة؟

options.text: To stay dry
Avoid rotor downwash, avoid being struck by lowered hook/cable, maintain visual line for observer, avoid helicopter exhaust gases
For shade
There is no specific rule

correct.text: Correct. Fire team positioning serves four purposes: (1) avoid rotor downwash that can knock men down, (2) avoid being struck by lowered winch hook (which carries dangerous static electricity), (3) maintain visual line on the operation, (4) avoid helicopter exhaust which contains carbon monoxide. Standard position: upwind or crosswind, 15-20m from winching circle.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. وضع فريق الإطفاء له أربع أهداف: (1) تجنب تيار الدوار الذي قد يطرحهم، (2) تجنب ضربة من خطاف الرفع الهابط (يحمل كهرباء ساكنة خطرة)، (3) الحفاظ على رؤية العملية، (4) تجنب عوادم الهليكوبتر التي تحوي CO. الوضع القياسي: عكس الريح أو متعامد، 15-20 متر من دائرة الرفع.

incorrect.text: All options except B are non-operational. Position is dictated by safety, observation, and tactical readiness.
incorrect.text_ar: كل الخيارات عدا B غير تشغيلية. الموقع يحدده السلامة والمراقبة والجاهزية التكتيكية.

real_consequence.description: Static-electricity discharge from lowered winch hook can incapacitate crew (10,000+ volts). Rotor downwash has knocked over standing crew. Position discipline saves the fire team.
real_consequence.psc_link: Inadequate fire team training for helicopter ops → STCW VI/3 (advanced fire fighting) competence finding.

scene_setup.context: Helicopter pilot has requested specific relative wind. Master must hold heading and speed steady within ±5° and ±1 knot during the entire winching operation.

dialogue.speaker: Master
dialogue.english: Helmsman, hand steering. Course 075. Maintain. Helmsman acknowledge.
dialogue.arabic: Helmsman، توجيه يدوي. الاتجاه 075. حافظ عليه. Helmsman أكد.

interaction.question: What is the typical course/speed tolerance during helicopter winching from a merchant ship?
interaction.question_ar: ما هو الهامش المسموح للاتجاه/السرعة أثناء الرفع من سفينة تجارية؟

options.text: ±30° course, ±10 knots speed
Approximately ±5° course, ±1 knot speed — manual steering, hand telegraph, no autopilot, no autonomous engine telegraph movement
Anything is fine — pilot adjusts
Stop the vessel completely

correct.text: Correct. ICS Guide standard: as steady as practical — typically ±5° course and ±1 knot speed during winching. Use HAND STEERING (autopilot can over-correct), no autonomous telegraph movement. STOPPING the vessel removes steerage and creates roll/heave that destabilizes winching.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. معيار ICS: ثابت قدر الإمكان — عادة ±5° اتجاه و ±1 عقدة سرعة أثناء الرفع. استخدم التوجيه اليدوي (الـ autopilot قد يبالغ بالتصحيح)، لا حركة تلغراف ذاتية. إيقاف السفينة يزيل التوجيه ويولّد لفاً/هيف يزعزع الرفع.

incorrect.text: Option C is CRITICAL — pilot CANNOT compensate for sudden course/speed changes during a winch. Stopping (D) is dangerous in seaway. The art is steady, predictable motion.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيار C كارثي — الطيار لا يستطيع التعويض عن تغيرات مفاجئة. الإيقاف (D) خطر في البحر. الفن في الحركة الثابتة المتوقعة.

real_consequence.description: Sudden course/speed changes during winching have caused the cable to swing, the patient stretcher to strike the deck or hull, and the helicopter to enter dangerous attitudes. Cited in multiple SAR after-action reports.
real_consequence.psc_link: Bridge team management failure during emergency drill → STCW + ISM finding.

scene_setup.context: C/O briefs the hookman on the four big risks: static discharge, rotor downwash, cable swing, and accidental winch release.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Officer (to hookman)
dialogue.english: Listen carefully. Four critical risks. One — STATIC DISCHARGE. The lowered cable carries thousands of volts. NEVER touch it before it grounds on deck. Wait for the hook to hit metal first. Two — ROTOR DOWNWASH. Brace yourself. Three — CABLE SWING. If the cable swings, do NOT chase it. Step back. Wait. Four — ACCIDENTAL RELEASE. Wear gloves, never wrap cable around hand or arm. Acknowledge each.
dialogue.arabic: اسمعني جيداً. أربعة مخاطر حرجة. واحد — التفريغ الكهربائي. الكابل المنزّل يحمل آلاف الفولتات. لا تلمسه قبل أن يلامس السطح. انتظر الخطاف يضرب المعدن أولاً. اثنان — تيار الدوار. ثبت نفسك. ثلاثة — تأرجح الكابل. إذا تأرجح، لا تطارده. تراجع. انتظر. أربعة — الانفلات الخاطئ. ارتدِ قفازات، لا تلف الكابل حول يدك أو ذراعك. أكد كل واحدة.
dialogue.radio_short: HOOKMAN — 4 RISKS: 1 STATIC (NEVER TOUCH BEFORE GROUND). 2 DOWNWASH (BRACE). 3 SWING (STEP BACK). 4 RELEASE (GLOVES, NO WRAP). ACK ALL.

dialogue.speaker: Hookman
dialogue.english: Chief, acknowledged. Static — wait for ground. Downwash — brace. Swing — step back. Release — gloves, no wrap. Ready, sir.
dialogue.arabic: Chief، مفهوم. التفريغ — انتظر التأريض. التيار — ثبت. التأرجح — تراجع. الانفلات — قفازات، لا لف. جاهز يا سيدي.
dialogue.radio_short: CHIEF — ACK. STATIC WAIT GROUND. DOWNWASH BRACE. SWING BACK. RELEASE GLOVES NO WRAP. READY SIR.

interaction.question: Helicopter winch cable is descending toward your hookman. What MUST he do FIRST?
interaction.question_ar: كابل الرفع نازل تجاه الـ hookman. ما يجب أن يفعله أولاً؟

options.text: Reach up and grab the hook to bring it down faster
Wait until the hook touches the deck and discharges static, THEN handle it with gloves
Wrap cable around forearm for grip
Catch the cable mid-air with bare hands

correct.text: Correct. The lowered cable accumulates thousands of volts of static electricity from rotor friction with air. Touching it before it grounds = severe electrical shock, possible cardiac arrest. ALWAYS wait for the hook to touch the deck first. Then handle with gloves.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الكابل المنزّل يجمع آلاف الفولتات من الكهرباء الساكنة بسبب احتكاك الدوار بالهواء. لمسه قبل التأريض = صدمة شديدة وربما سكتة قلبية. دائماً انتظر الخطاف يلامس السطح أولاً. ثم استخدم القفازات.

incorrect.text: Options A, C, D are all CRITICAL — each has caused crew injury in real maritime SAR operations. Static, wrap, and bare-hand catch are textbook examples of how hookmen get hurt.
incorrect.text_ar: الخيارات A و C و D كلها كارثية — كل واحد سبّب إصابة طاقم في عمليات إنقاذ بحرية حقيقية. التفريغ، اللف، والقبض باليد المجردة أمثلة كلاسيكية على إصابات الـ hookman.

real_consequence.description: Static electricity from helicopter winch cables has injured shipboard hookmen in multiple documented MEDEVAC operations. The 'wait for ground' rule is the single most important hookman safety procedure.
real_consequence.psc_link: Untrained hookman during emergency operation → STCW + ISM Element 6 (Resources & Personnel) finding.

interaction.question: What is the BEST way to handle a discovered GMDSS log gap before a PSC inspection?
interaction.question_ar: ما أفضل طريقة لمعالجة فجوة سجل GMDSS مكتشفة قبل تفتيش PSC؟

options.text: Falsify entries with original ink to look continuous
Make a clear retrospective entry: original date, today's date of correction, brief reason, signed by Master/responsible officer
Hide the log from inspector
Tear out the page

correct.text: Correct. Honesty + transparent correction is the only acceptable approach. Falsification (A), concealment (C), or destruction (D) of GMDSS records is criminal under SOLAS, ITU Radio Regulations, and most national maritime law. Retrospective entries with clear notation = professional self-correction.
correct.text_ar: صحيح. الصدق + التصحيح الشفاف هو النهج الوحيد المقبول. التزوير (A)، الإخفاء (C)، أو التمزيق (D) لسجلات GMDSS جريمة بموجب SOLAS و ITU وقوانين معظم الدول. القيد الرجعي مع ملاحظة واضحة = تصحيح مهني ذاتي.

incorrect.text: Options A, C, D are CRITICAL — each is a criminal offense. Master who falsifies records faces license revocation and potential imprisonment in many jurisdictions.
